author: CNT Valladolid
title: El nuevo local de CNT en Valladolid abre sus puertas
content:
Antifascistas, antirracistas, anticapitalistas, transfeministas e internacionalistas. En medio de una convocatoria de huelga general por la vivienda y contra todos los poderes que viven de desangrar a la clase trabajadora, CNT Valladolid inaugura un nuevo local en calle Merced, 6, de Valladolid, entre las plazas de Santa Cruz y Circular.


Hace más de dos años empezamos un proyecto muy ilusionante. Nuestro local se quedaba pequeño y teníamos que buscar otro. Hicimos un proceso de reflexión colectiva, para tener claras nuestras necesidades presentes y futuras. Una tienda de fontanería se ha convertido en un sindicato como el nuestro, con más salas donde reunirse, un salón amplio en el que convocar actos… Un nuevo espacio en Valladolid a disposición de todas las personas trabajadoras.


A pesar de que quedan retoques, el pasado 17 de octubre nos decidimos a abrir puertas en un acto en el que nos reunimos la afiliacIón con personas afines del presente y del futuro. Contamos con las actuaciones de Jesús Puebla MImo, de Rubén Ruiz, Rosa Vicente y José Luis Alonso, de Chusma y de Juguillos, de Astrolabio, y tuvimos ocasión de mover el esqueleto con las aportaciones de Eva DJ. No faltaron el recorrido por el nuevo local, el picoteo hecho a mano en comida y bebida, y sobre todo las ganas de llenar de vida esta nueva casa para la rebeldía y la defensa frente a empresaurios y politicastros de todos nuestros derechos actuales y los que nos inventemos en el futuro. Para todo ello y más, contad con CNT, vuestra herramienta de lucha, vuestro sindicato de clase, vuestra alternativa sindical.


A continuación hemos puesto en marcha unas jornadas de inauguración de las que tenéis información en inauguracion.cntvalladolid.es


Reproducimos a continuación el manifiesto que refleja esta nueva etapa:


Hoy, sábado, 17 de octubre, inauguramos una nueva etapa en CNT Valladolid.


Estrenamos un espacio más amplio. Un espacio donde pueda entrar más gente, donde podamos encontrarnos, organizarnos y construir juntas una respuesta colectiva a la realidad que vivimos.


Porque este local no es solamente un lugar nuevo. Es un espacio de encuentro para quienes entendemos que nuestros derechos no son concesiones, que la dignidad no se negocia y que nuestra fuerza está en la lucha obrera.


Y cuando decimos clase trabajadora, no hablamos solo de quienes tienen un contrato o un empleo. También hablamos de quienes trabajan sin derechos, de quienes sostienen los cuidados y de quienes encuentran las puertas cerradas al empleo por su identidad o su condición.


Porque si el sistema utiliza esas diferencias para dividirnos y para colocar a unas personas en posiciones de mayor vulnerabilidad, el sindicalismo tiene que hacer justamente lo contrario:

reconocernos como parte de una misma clase y organizarnos juntas.


Por eso abrimos este espacio.


Para que haya más gente, más organización y más lucha.


Porque somos CNT


CNT tiene una historia profundamente ligada a la organización de la clase trabajadora y a la lucha por los derechos laborales y sociales.


Antes que este local, CNT tuvo varios, cada uno con su historia: desahucios, asaltos policiales, atentados… Desde la calle Francisco Zarandona multiplicó por diez su afiliación en tiempos de la segunda republica; desde los pactos de la moncloa, superando multiples dificultades, hemos crecido en varios locales en Valladolid que han ido abriendo cada vez más brecha en la provincia y en la ciudad. Hasta llegar a este en el que nos encontramos


Somos anarcosindicalistas. Entendemos que quienes vivimos de nuestro trabajo tenemos capacidad para defender nuestros derechos colectivamente y para construir otras formas de relacionarnos y organizarnos frente a la explotación.


Tenemos una memoria sindical fuerte y combativa. Pero no queremos convertir esa memoria en una fotografía, ni mirar hacia atrás únicamente para recordar lo que fuimos.

Nuestra memoria nos obliga a mirar hacia delante.


Porque el sistema contra el que se organizaron quienes nos precedieron no ha desaparecido. La explotación adopta nuevas formas. La precariedad se normaliza. Trabajar ya no garantiza unas condiciones de vida dignas. Y quienes acumulan riqueza siguen teniendo capacidad para decidir sobre nuestras vidas.


Por eso estamos aquí.


Porque la lucha sigue


Y esa lucha sigue hoy en múltiples frentes que se complementan.


Una de ellas es la

lucha antifascista

.

author: Acratosaurio rex
title: Una posibilidad con la huelga general
content:
El Tribunal Constitucional definió la huelga como una perturbación que se produce en el normal desarrollo de la vida social y en particular en el proceso de producción de bienes y de servicios que se lleva a cabo en forma pacífica y no violenta. De esta definición lo principal que quiero destacar, es que que según sentencia, la huelga perturba la normalidad, y sobre todo paraliza, la producción de cosas…, de mercancías. Y, en definitiva, frena en seco el capitalismo, la explotación, la acumulación de riqueza en manos de cuatro tunantes. La propaganda estatal se suprime: artículos de prensa, la televisión, las redes sociales: todo a la mierda, todo a la puta mierda, y hasta el cambio climático se toma un respiro. Ahí está, cagüen dios, la huelga general.

Por supuesto los mequetrefes que dirigen el cotarro se sonríen. Piensan que nunca se pondrán de acuerdo los productores, ya sea por miedo, por ignorancia o por necesidad. Ponen en marcha toda su maquinaria de propaganda para quitar las ganas al más pintado: la muestran como contraproducente, te recuerdan que perderás cuatro perras, y te juran en el nombre de sus atrofiados genitales, que nunca conseguirás nada. Bueno, yo huelo esos discursos como si estuvieran tirándose pedos en un pastel de bodas.

Porque, si es tan inútil es el paro voluntario, si lanzar los trastos por la ventana y fastidiarles la ganancia no les joroba… ¿Por qué esos mafiosos de ahí arriba, esa gentuza que te chupa la sangre y te desprecia, le tiene tanto pánico? Joder, si han elaborado una legislación que le viene como anillo al dedo a esos mamarrachos de alto standing: servicios mínimos que son máximos, jueces estudiando al dedillo si la huelga puede ser declarada ilegal, requisitos legales para presentar la demanda… Y un ejército de comemierdas para liarla a tiros. ¿Qué nos indica eso? Claro que sí: quiénes más pavor tienen, son ellos.

Por supuesto, mucha gente no lo verá claro. Normal, teniendo en cuenta que a diario nos echan el sermón y habrá trabajadores que no se cosquen. Pero para echar a andar, no hace falta que todo el mundo esté de acuerdo. No es necesario que veinte comités políticos pacten, o que una minoría de gilipollas elabore alambicados planes. No. No es preciso que todos los sindicatos se pongan manos a la obra. A la vista está: esta huelga la han exigido los de las acampadas, los manifestantes, por pura necesidad, por dignidad, por rabia que sale de las tripas, por el desahucio de una anciana que ha reventado las entrañas de la población. A las organizaciones formales, no les ha quedado otra que seguir el juego. Unos cuantos jóvenes se ponen en marcha ocupando el terreno, y dan un bofetón en la jeta de los políticos y de los patrones, obligando a poner en agenda los problemas de los currelas, que demasiado bien sabes cuáles son.

Así que sí, que vengan los fuegos artificiales. Que esta huelga sea el primer paso para un jaleo que acabe con la acumulación obscena de plata que tienen los capitalistas españoles, europeos, mundiales, porque la cosa se está calentando, y estos días en Francia, en Alemania, Bélgica, Portugal, Italia, Albania… El motín se generaliza. Únete a la batalla, apoya a los grupos que se preparan, presta tu fuerza a la masa, porque el día que dejemos de sostener el mundo, el día que los trabajadores digan que a hacer puñetas, esta locura de mundo se irá por el retrete. Y ese día, puede empezar en noviembre. Hoy mismo puede estar en el orden del día.

title: Galiza no es tierra de fascistas
content:
Galiza no es tierra de fascistas


«Es necesario darse cuenta de que la violencia-hambre, la violencia-miseria, la violencia-opresión, la violencia-subdesarrollo, la violencia-tortura conducen a la violencia-secuestro, a la violencia-terrorismo, a la violencia-guerrilla; y que es muy importante comprender quién pone en práctica la violencia: si son los que provocan la miseria o los que luchan contra ella…»


— Julio Cortázar, Corrección de pruebas, 1973


La juventud gallega nos da una lección


Vox no tiene en Galicia ni un solo concejal. Ni uno. Aun así, el primer acto preelectoral de Santiago Abascal en nuestra tierra, en la plaza de María Pita de A Coruña, se encontró con lo que merecía: una multitud. Mientras el líder ultra hablaba desde un atril, en una esquina de la plaza y rodeado de un grupito de seguidores, al otro lado, tras una barrera formada por una docena de furgones policiales y agentes antidisturbios, se concentraban unas 5.000 personas, según las cifras del propio Ayuntamiento. Las convocaban Galiza Nova, el Sindicato da Vivenda y la Coordenadora da Mocidade Socialista. Gritaban «No pasarán», «Galicia será la tumba del fascismo» y «Ninguna persona es ilegal». Y siguieron gritándolo cuando Abascal ya se había ido.


La ignorancia fascista necesita un odio irracional para sembrar sus mentiras y cosechar sus frutos podridos. En Galiza, ninguna de esas semillas ha germinado. La juventud gallega es un orgullo y un ejemplo de lucha antifascista.


Las cargas llegaron cuando el fascista ya no estaba


Y entonces llegó la policía. Las cargas empezaron cuando Abascal y sus seguidores ya habían abandonado la plaza: pelotas de goma, gases lacrimógenos y porrazos. Galiza Nova denuncia una «represión desmedida» y habla de «múltiples personas gravemente heridas», de agresiones a militantes que no mostraban ningún comportamiento violento y de un afiliado detenido. Las personas asistentes y las organizaciones convocantes hablan de una actuación desproporcionada e indiscriminada. Hubo quien respondió a los golpes con lo que tenía a mano: piedras, sillas y botellas. Se defendían.


Esa misma tarde, unas 2.000 personas se concentraron ante la Subdelegación del Gobierno para rechazar la represión del derecho de protesta. En la concentración participaron dirigentes del BNG y de la CIG, el sindicato mayoritario de Galiza, al que me honro en pertenecer. Allí estuvimos y allí tenemos que seguir estando: del lado de quienes salen a la calle contra el fascismo, y no del lado de quienes los reciben a porrazos.


Un país que no ha roto con el franquismo


Se habla mucho de la llegada del fascismo al poder en Europa, y con razón. Pero en el Estado español no hablamos de una amenaza: hablamos de una realidad. El fascismo nunca se fue. Sigue vivo dentro de las estructuras del poder.


Por eso existe una «Fundación Francisco Franco» que exalta al dictador genocida y gestiona la apertura al público del Pazo de Meirás, el mismo pazo que los fascistas obligaron al pueblo a «regalarle». Por eso hay jueces que paralizan la retirada de las placas que dan a nuestras calles los nombres de genocidas. Por eso se ofician misas en memoria del golpista. Por eso los restos de los fascistas siguen en el Valle de los Caídos, tumba colectiva también de sus víctimas, mientras se toleran homenajes a los verdugos, para escarnio de los republicanos obligados a levantar aquel mausoleo y de las familias que aún buscan a los suyos. Por eso miles de personas asesinadas siguen en fosas comunes. Y por eso la Real Academia de la Historia llama «régimen autoritario» a la dictadura de Franco y presenta a Negrín, jefe de un Gobierno legítimo, como un dictador: el relato de los vencedores, repetido con sello académico.


Golpe de Estado, no guerra civil


Y por eso seguimos diciendo «Guerra Civil». Fue un golpe de Estado militar, con la ayuda de la Alemania nazi y de la Italia fascista, contra un Gobierno democrático. A ese golpe siguieron una guerra y una posguerra de exterminio contra la izquierda y contra cuantos pensaban de manera diferente. Lo lideraron militares que traicionaron su juramento de lealtad a la República.


Quién es fascista y quién no


Conviene no confundirse. Quien piensa de manera diferente y defiende su postura con argumentos, los compartamos o no, no es fascista. El fascismo no usa argumentos porque no los tiene: sus argumentos son la mentira, la fuerza y la violencia. Por eso con el fascismo no se discute. Al fascismo se le combate en …

Συμμετέχουμε στην αντιφασιστική – αντιρατσιστική


συγκέντρωση στην πλατεία Βικτωρίας


Τη Δευτέρα 12 Οκτωβρίου στις 21:00 το βράδυ, ομάδα 15-20 φασιστών επιτέθηκε σε βάρος δύο προσφύγων μαθητών έξω από το 6ο Εσπερινό ΓΕΛ Αθηνών – ένα σχολείο όπου φοιτούν παιδιά της εργατικής τάξης, ντόπιοι και μετανάστες που παλεύουν για ένα μεροκάματο. Ο απολογισμός ήταν να νοσηλευτεί ο ένας σε σοβαρή κατάσταση και διασωληνωμένος έπειτα από πισώπλατη μαχαιριά που δέχτηκε, και ο άλλος με τραύματα από ξυλοδαρμό. Η έρευνα της αστυνομίας για το περιστατικό κωλυσιεργεί και προσιδιάζει σε συγκάλυψη, όμοια με τα «στραβά μάτια» που έκανε στις επιθέσεις της Χρυσής Αυγής, ενώ ήδη κυκλοφορούν βίντεο που ταυτοποιούν τους δράστες. Η παραπάνω δολοφονική επίθεση έρχεται να προστεθεί σε μια σειρά φασιστικών χτυπημάτων που έχουν σημειωθεί σε βάρος προσφύγων, μεταναστών και αντιφασιστών αγωνιστών του κινήματος, τόσο στις λαϊκές γειτονιές του Κέντρου (Άγιος Παντελεήμονας, Σεπόλια, Κολωνός,Κυψέλη,Παγκρατι) όσο και σε εργατικές περιοχές, όπως η πρόσφατη επίθεση με μαχαίρι στην Ελευσίνα.


Τα παραπάνω θυμίζουν έντονα τα πογκρόμ της Χρυσής Αυγής. Η πρόσφατη αποφυλάκιση του φασίστα Κασιδιάρη, η δραστηριοποίηση μελών της Propatria και η επανεμφάνιση του μετώπου νεολαίας της Χρυσής Αυγής μαρτυρούν την οργανωμένη προσπάθεια των φασιστών να ξαναβγούν στους δρόμους. Στόχος τους είναι να λειτουργήσουν ξανά ως το μακρύ χέρι του συστήματος: να στρέψουν τον εξαθλιωμένο κόσμο της δουλειάς ενάντια στους πιο καταπιεσμένους, κρύβοντας τον πραγματικό υπεύθυνο για τη φτώχεια μας. Η ευθύνη της κυβέρνησης είναι τεράστια και εγκληματική. Την ίδια στιγμή που η κυβερνητική πολιτική τσακίζει τις ζωές μας, ο Υπουργός Προστασίας του Πολίτη προαναγγέλλει πογκρόμ και καλεί σε χαφιεδισμό σε βάρος μεταναστών, κλείνοντας το μάτι στα φασιστικά τάγματα εφόδου για να αποπροσανατολίσει την κοινωνική οργή. Μη χάνοντας ευκαιρία, στις γειτονιές της Κυψέλης κυκλοφορεί κάλεσμα από ένα σύλλογο που καλει τον κόσμο να καταδιδει σε αυτους και την αστυνομία όπου εντοπίζει συγκατοίκηση μεταναστών, προσπαθώντας να κανιβαλίσουν την κοινωνική δυσαρέσκεια.


Κυβέρνηση, αστυνομία, αφεντικά και φασίστες συνεργάζονται για να επιβάλουν τον φόβο. Την ώρα που η καλπάζουσα ακρίβεια στα είδη πρώτης ανάγκης, τα απλησίαστα ενοίκια και η στεγαστική κρίση διώχνουν τις εργατικές οικογένειες και τη νεολαία από τις ίδιες τους τις γειτονιές, η κυβέρνηση και το κεφάλαιο θέλουν τους μετανάστες χωρίς έγγραφα και δικαιώματα. Τους θέλουν απομονωμένους, ώστε να αποτελούν ένα απόλυτα αναλώσιμο και φθηνό εργατικό δυναμικό, έρμαιο στις ορέξεις της εργοδοσίας, συμπιέζοντας τους μισθούς όλων μας. Θέλουν να επιβάλουν παντού «νέες Μανωλάδες» της άγριας εκμετάλλευσης. Χαρακτηριστικό παράδειγμα αποτελεί η σωρεία εργατικών ατυχημάτων (εργατικών δολοφονιών) Αράβων μεταναστών στο μεγάλο κατασκευαστικό κάτεργο του Ελληνικού, εκεί όπου τα κέρδη των κεφαλαιούχων ποτίζονται με το αίμα της τάξης μας.


Οι γειτονιές, τα σχολεία και οι πλατείες μας ανήκουν σε ντόπιους και μετανάστες που ζουν, υποφέρουν από την ίδια ακρίβεια και παλεύουν μαζί. Δεν θα επιτρέψουμε στους φασίστες να γίνουν οι μαντρόσκυλα των αφεντικών και της κυβέρνησης στις γειτονιές μας. Απέναντι στον διαχωρισμό με βάση τη φυλή ή την καταγωγή, εμείς προτάσσουμε την ταξική αλληλεγγύη. Φασίστες, κράτος και κεφάλαιο θα βρίσκουν απέναντί τους την οργανωμένη, κοινή μας δράση για ζωή, στέγαση, δουλειά και αξιοπρέπεια.

author: By Sean Summers, Unicorn Riot
title: Line 5 Opponents Confront Wis. Gov. Evers: ‘Drink the Future Water of Lake Superior’
content:
Milwaukee, WI — As Governor Tony Evers took the stage during the annual Wisconsin Association for Justice dinner, an audience member rose to lead a toast for the state’s leader.


But rather than honoring Evers’ accomplishments, the patron issued a challenge. Thrusting a glass of thick black fluid into the air, Tom Hoy asked Evers to drink the liquid which served as a representation of Lake Superior’s waters which protesters say will be contaminated by oil and other hazardous waste from Enbridge’s Line 5 pipeline if the state, and Evers specifically, doesn’t revoke the company’s construction permits.


“I have a glass of water with crude oil,” Hoy announced, holding aloft a cup filled with liquid resembling oil-laden water. “Will you drink the future waters of Lake Superior, sir?”


Hoy, an activist with the group

Climate Defiance

, continued to challenge Evers to have a drink as attendees, security personnel and police shoved them out of the audience and toward the door.


Protesters attended the dinner calling on Evers to reject the pipeline not on vague objections to the project but under specific conditions spelled out in the state’s agreement with the company.


See all of Unicorn Riot’s Line 5 Coverage


Under the Line 5 reroute

permit issued

 in 2024 to Enbridge by the Wisconsin Department of Natural Resources, or DNR, the state has the right to terminate the project for good cause, including if the project is not completed according to the conditions of the permit.


Activists, and increasingly the state itself, say that Enbridge’s work has fallen outside the scope of the original permit and violated numerous state regulations.


On October 13, the Wisconsin DNR issued a

Notice of Violation

 to Enbridge for what it calls a “persistent pattern of non-compliance” stretching back to at least March of this year.


The violations listed in the notice include unpermitted construction, unpermitted activity in wetlands and other waterways, and violations of air quality laws, among others.


Language in the permit says that no work outside the originally approved plan the company submitted is allowed, but in September the company

began construction on an unpermitted reroute

 for the pipeline in response to a rupture this summer.


And on August 25, the company was responsible for what’s been called the state’s

largest oil spill

 in more than 50 years when an unoccupied truck rolled into a section of Line 5 at a work site. The

line ruptured

, leading to 31,000 barrels, or 1.3 million gallons, of natural gas spilling just east of the Bad River Reservation in Iron county.


Related:

Enbridge Line 5 Spills Natural Gas Liquids in Northern Wisconsin


In light of the violations and pattern of not complying with state rules, opponents are calling on Evers, the state’s top executive, to exercise his power to revoke the permit.


“If he has a conscience, he needs to act now on the power he has right now to cancel the Line 5 permits,” Hoy, the oil-toasting protester, said in a recorded statement shortly after the disruption happened.


Immediately after Hoy was ejected, another Climate Defiance activist approached the stage calling on Evers to reject the Line 5 permits. They were quickly confronted by an attendee, but resisted removal while demanding the governor consider his legacy and stop work on the pipeline.


The action is the latest in an ongoing battle against the Canadian oil company’s reconstruction of the Line 5 pipeline. For years, organizers have opposed the project on the grounds that it violates Native sovereignty and poses a dire threat to the region’s fresh water, all while accelerating climate change by propping up fossil fuel infrastructure.

author: Ben Hillier
title: ‘Post-truth’ politics is business as usual
content:
Since Donald Trump’s arrival on the scene more than a decade ago, lying in politics has become ever more shameless. It’s the “post-truth politics” era, apparently. Oxford Dictionaries, which crowned “post-truth” the word of the year when Trump first took up residence at the White House, noted that “it describes not just particular assertions, but a general characteristic of our age”. The

Economist

 wrote at the time:

“His brazenness is not punished, but taken as evidence of his willingness to stand up to elite power … [Post-truth politics] picks out the heart of what is new: that truth is not falsified, or contested, but of secondary importance. Feelings, not facts, are what matter in this sort of campaigning.”

Yet if “post-truth” is characterised by emotional appeals and relegating facts to the sidelines, it’s not clear that politics has fundamentally changed at all.

On a 2008 autumn night in Grant Park, Chicago, Democratic president-elect Barack Obama, promoted as an articulate Harvard Law graduate with a firm grasp on reality, addressed an enormous crowd. The backdrop was an emerging economic depression: millions of workers were being sacked, more than 3 million homes had been foreclosed in the previous 24 months, the financial system had collapsed, and tent cities of the newly homeless were springing up on the edges of cities across America.

“The true strength of our nation comes … from the enduring power of our ideals: democracy, liberty, opportunity”, Obama promised. “This is our time … to reclaim the American dream and reaffirm that fundamental truth, that, out of many, we are one.” His optimistic gesture was one of the finest moments for the politics of feeling, the culmination of a campaign run on vague notions of hope, change and the slogan “Yes, we can”—appropriated from the mass struggle of undocumented migrants, millions of whom he would go on to deport as president.

Yet Obama’s oration wasn’t considered “post-truth”, because the sentiments, similarly articulated by most political leaders in the democratic West for the last century, were underpinned by unchallenged liberal certainties: that under capitalism, anyone can “make it”, that improvement is the child of hard work, that all individual interests can be accommodated within the national interest. 

“Dream, believe, achieve.” Vacuous aphorisms of this variety are the bedrock of capitalist politics. They aren’t facts or truths, but expressions of an idealised liberal-democratic world whose promises have never been realised. Yet they endure. So why only now are we said to live in a world of post-truth politics? Probably because the empty pledges of progress and prosperity have given way to messages and tones that reflect an era of social decline and political decay at odds with the vision of the world that liberals remain desperate to believe. 

Marketing the truth

Many have pointed out that the last four decades of rapacious free trade and economic and political crises sowed the seeds of this post-truth age. Soaring inequality, greater economic precariousness, more and more people expected to fend for themselves against the forces of globalised capitalism. So British commentator George Monbiot wrote in the

Guardian

 that “Donald Trump’s election started in England in 1975”, when Margaret Thatcher took over the leadership of the Conservative Party and got everyone reading, and later implementing, the work of Frederick Hayek.

This focus on a purportedly neoliberal economy in producing the “Trumpian moment” (and the broader rise of the far right) misses the universal aspect of this so-called post-truth era. Capitalism is based on theft, and all pro-capitalist politics—far right, conservative, libertarian, liberal, even social democratic—exists to cover up or justify it. Pro-capitalist politics is fundamentally about deceiving people into thinking the system is either fair or natural, when it is neither. 

Nearly 200 years ago, Karl Marx and Frederick Engels first wrote of the stripping away of humanity that came with capitalism’s emergence from the old medieval order:

“The capitalist class, wherever it has got the upper hand, has put an end to all feudal, patriarchal, idyllic relations. It has … left remaining no other nexus between man and man than naked self-interest, than callous ‘cash payment’ … It has resolved personal worth into exchange value, and in place of the numberless indefeasible chartered freedoms, has set up that single …

content:
Author

: SA

Title

: On Political Ecosystems

Date

: August 5 2026

Source

: Retrieved on 2026-10-21 from

<organisemagazine.org.uk/2026/08/05/on-political-ecosystems>


 We recently had a few members of National Rebirth in Preston. They popped up with a table and some of their fascy literature and ugly flags, and attempted some conversations with passers by. They were spotted by members of our local antifascist ecosystem, who took photos, shared information in community group chats, and observed.


 I wasn’t there at the time. Being a more militant organism in our local ecosystem, I would have happily gone down and told them to get the fuck back to whatever rock they crawled out from under and never return. We had a brief chat in one of our groups and opinions on National Rebirth are mixed: some consider them to not be much of a threat, or not a serious threat, but I am not so sure.


 I took a look at their website and was particularly surprised to find some very transparent writings about their aims, strategies, and branch goings-on. All veiled with the usual fascist dogwhistles and indirections of course. There is one article in particular I found very interesting, and which I want to deconstruct here.


 In “The Nationalist Ecosystem – It DOES exist, and it is a curse, not a blessing”, Grand Wizard Alek Yerbury develops an analysis of the disconnects between ‘nationalist’ activists and local communities. To briefly summarise Yerbury’s argument, he views “protests, demonstrations and street movements” and “‘Auditing’, ‘Youtubing’, and ‘Streaming’” as “staple activities of this nationalist ecosystem” which is ultimately doing nothing but perpetuating itself, and will “never develop into real political power”. Having recently read D. Hunter’s “Chav Solidarity”, I was surprised to find some parallels with his analyses, of the disconnects between “capital heavy” activists and people who are poor, working class, or criminalised. Hunter makes similar observations of the anarchist and leftist ecosystems from the other side, as a member of a local community trying to participate in what is in effect somebody else’s political ecosystem. He talks about escaping from a violent and racist upbringing, only to find countless activists and activist groups unable to engage with him or people like him with anything but contempt. As he puts so eloquently:


 I believe that the working class in this country has been thoroughly stratified, in a way which makes revolutionary change almost impossible, but I believe this can be repaired. It requires those who sit at the top of the pile to understand that they are living off bread crumbs, and in many cases I think they do, but what isn’t recognized enough is that when they catch bread crumbs, others are going without. And for sure, we should want the whole fucking loaf, but people are gonna find it hard to fight for that loaf if they’re hungry and it’s gonna be even harder if they’re being told what to do by people who are keeping the crumbs they catch to themselves.


 Both Yerbury and Hunter point to the ways political activists of all stripes cut themselves off from the very people outside of their movements that they want and need to bring into their movements. For Yerbury, the “parallel society” constituted by the far right’s organising activities are a distraction, “an echo chamber of pre-vetted, pre-screened people”. His point is that the internal cultures we develop through our collective practices might bring us closer together, but are also inherently exclusionary, forming shibboleths, and presenting barriers to audiences and potential new members, who must learn our language, so to speak. For Hunter, radical leftist spaces may preset themselves as inclusive, while also completely lacking all the individual and collective interpersonal and structural skills that are needed to actually include people who are different from us. Further, he shows how this situation is a deliberate construction of white supremacy, cisheteropatriarchy, capitalism, and the class system:


 If I was unable to pay my rent or feed myself in a socially acceptable fashion, or sub-culturally acceptable by squatting and skipping, would I be treated in comradely fashion? Perhaps. But if I lived with the stress of going day to day without knowing where my next meal would come from or where I would sleep, would I behave in ways that would be acceptable? title: Francs-Tireurs Partisans (1991-1999) : s'attaquer à l'extrême droite, autrement qu'avec des mots
content:
Nous avons décidé de revenir sur certains événements marquants de l'histoire de l'antifascisme hexagonal contemporain, pour remettre en lumière une histoire militante parfois méconnue dans nos propres rangs et éclairer les luttes d'aujourd'hui avec les combats d'hier. Voici le premier des trois épisodes d'une petite histoire du groupe marseillais Francs-Tireurs Partisans qui, dans la dernière décennie du XXe siècle, s'en est pris aux intérêts du Front national dans la région de Marseille.


Première partie (1/3) : Les Francs-Tireurs Partisans, genèse d'un combat antifasciste à Marseille.


Marseille, 7h le matin du 15 octobre 1999. Au terme de huit années d'enquête la police arrête à leurs domiciles Yves Peirat et William Ferrari. Ces deux militants libertaires sont accusés d'avoir commis des attentats sous le nom de « FTP » pour Francs-Tireurs Partisans, un acronyme qui convoque l'imaginaire de la résistance à la dictature de Vichy et à l'occupant nazi. Le groupe marseillais qui se réclame de l'antifascisme radical à mis en action une forme de « résistance active ». Il a « officiellement »

 [

1

]

 revendiqué 12 attentats entre 1991 et 1998, en grande majorité dirigés contre les intérêts du FN. Des agissements qui se limitent à des destructions matérielles, les enquêteurs eux-mêmes souligneront qu'aucun engin n'était destiné à tuer. Leur histoire est la collision d'un moment et d'un environnement particulier. La région Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur est alors le terrain de conquête privilégié de l'extrême droite. Elle y trouve enfin l'occasion d'accéder aux affaires, bien aidée par l'inconsistance et parfois la complaisance d'adversaires politiques n'opposant que la vacuité de discours rendus caducs par l'affairisme et le clientélisme ambiant. Le FN progresse à grands pas, emportant par exemple des mairies. Son discours prospère sur un racisme qui n'a rien de latent, hérité de la guerre d'Algérie. Revenir sur l'histoire des FTP c'est se reposer la sempiternelle question de la performativité du militantisme antifasciste et révolutionnaire. Subir les offensives et les offenses de l'extrême droite : jusqu'à quel point ? Ou, pour le dire de manière à la fois explicite et poétique : « Je ne cherche pas à changer les règles du jeu, mais le jeu lui-même. »

 [

2

]

 Une phrase d'André Breton mise en exergue parmi les revendications des FTP. Une histoire récente qui mérite d'être remise sur l'établi parce qu'elle renvoie les militant·e·s pour l'émancipation à des dilemmes politiques et moraux dont nous ne sommes loin de nous départir.


L'extrême droite méridionale : la rage et la revanche en bandoulière


Pour comprendre l'irruption des FTP dans le paysage politique il faut revenir sur une des spécificités de la région Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur : « L'arrivée successive de deux communautés issues du même pays, l'Algérie, mais dont l'une portait sa rage et sa revanche en bandoulière a permis la renaissance d'une xénophobie jamais totalement éteinte depuis les chasses à l'Italien du début du siècle (Franc-Tireur, n°1, février 2000) ». Cette arrivée autour de 1962 et la guerre coloniale qui l'a précédé représente la matrice historique qui a conduit à la création du FN. À l'exemple de Jean-Marie Le Pen, jeune député poujadiste, qui s'engage volontairement en Algérie fin 1956 où il participe activement à ce qui ne peut être qualifié autrement que de torture. Parmi les différentes factions à la création du FN on retrouve nombre de nostalgiques de l'Algérie française (Roger Holeindre, Pierre Sergent) dont d'anciens membres de l'OAS (Organisation Armée Secrète) à l'origine de nombreux attentats en Algérie et en France. L'extrême droite dispose donc d'un terreau favorable en PACA, même si dans les années 1970 le FN stagne à un niveau électoral très faible, encore disqualifié dans les urnes et la vie politique publique par sa filiation avec Vichy, la collaboration et le nazisme. La libération n'est pas si lointaine et les blessures restent vives. Cela n'empêche pas les diverses composantes de l'extrême droite d'affirmer leur présence par des actions clandestines violentes et spectaculaires.

 [

3

]

 En PACA elles sont dirigées vers les immigré.es ou perçu.es comme tel.le.s qu'elle accuse de tous les maux. Posons quelques jalons chronologiques. En 1973, le Groupe Charles Martel organise un attentat contre le consulat d'Algérie à Marseille faisant quatre morts et entre 14 et 20 blessés selon les sources.


Cet attentat est l'acmé …

title: Am autoritären Kipppunkt: „Law and Order“-Politik hat Konjunktur
content:
Dossier


„… In der Klimaforschung ist ein Kipppunkt ein Moment, an dem – laut Weltklimarat – „eine kritische Grenze“ erreicht wird, „jenseits derer sich ein System umorganisiert“, neue Prozesse sich verfestigen und negative Dynamiken sich beschleunigen. Dies lässt sich auch auf gesellschaftliche Kipppunkte übertragen. Kipppunkte entstehen nicht zufällig, sie sind das Ergebnis länger zurückliegender destruktiver Prozesse. Doch im Gegensatz zum Klima sind gesellschaftliche Prozesse nie unumkehrbar. Allerdings sind etablierte Diskurse, Strukturen und Normen oft nicht rückgängig zu machen. Sind autoritäre Kipppunkte überschritten, wird der Boden brüchig, auf dem plurale und demokratische Gesellschaften stehen…“

Kommentar von Daniel Mullis, Maximilian Pichl und Vanessa E. Thompson vom 16. Juni 2023 in der taz online


, siehe mehr daraus und dazu:


[„Der Widerspruch gegen Rechtsextremismus erscheint dem Staat als Skandal“] Die Würde des Rechtsextremisten


„Die Frage des SPIEGEL, ob Deutschland nach links zu rutschen drohe, wirkt in einem Land, das seit Jahren jede Debatte durch die Linse eines angeblich allgegenwärtigen linken Feindes betrachtet, inzwischen wie ein Stück Realsatire. Während Politiker, Leitartikler und Talkshowrunden sich gebetsmühlenartig daran abarbeiten, dass die eigentliche Gefahr links stehe, hat sich eine bemerkenswerte Rechtsblindheit, ja Rechtsselbstverständlichkeit in Köpfen und Handlungen breitgemacht. Man zelebriert politisch wie medial jede Mücke am linken Horizont, aber übersieht den rechtsextremen Elefanten, der längst durch den fragilen Porzellanladen der Demokratie poltert. In meinem Ideal von Deutschland hätte der Staat jene jungen Menschen, die da in Halle entschlossen vor dem Tor der Synagoge standen geehrt. Er hätte ihnen aus tiefster Haltung heraus gedankt, weil sie uns vor einem beschämenden Eklat bewahrt haben. Dem Eklat, dass sich ein bekannter Rechtsextremist am Tatort eines rechtsextremistischen Anschlags auf jüdisches Leben am Tag des Gedenkens an diesen hagestolz ebendort in Szene setzt. (…)


In meiner Realität geschieht jedoch das Gegenteil. Und das auf allen Ebenen. Halle ist hier keine Ausnahme und daher auch kein Warnzeichen, sondern mittlerweile bundesrepublikanische Normalität. (…)


Eine Normalität, in welcher nicht die Würde der Opfer schützenswert erscheint, sondern die Würde dessen, der sich an ihrem Gedenktag in den Mittelpunkt drängte. Die Würde desjenigen als schützenswerter erachtet wurde, der das Gedenken an die Opfer medial wie faktisch durch seine Vereinahmung des Ortes und des Gedenkens zum Sieg über diese ummünzen wollte. Es geht hier nicht mehr um den Schutz von Würde, sondern um deren Pervertierung: Nicht dieser Affront steht hier staatlicherseits unter Verdacht, sondern der Widerstand gegen ihn. Und genau darin liegt das Bittere unserer Zeit: Der Widerspruch gegen Rechtsextremismus erscheint dem Staat als Skandal. (…)


Nicht, die gedachte Selbstverständlichkeit, dass einige junge Menschen einen Rechtsextremisten zurückgewiesen haben, sondern dass zu viele an den Wahlurnen finden, dass Rechtsextremisten wieder die Geschicke des Landes leiten sollen. Dass in den letzten Dekaden zu viele in Landes- und Bundespolitik das Verlieren des gesamtgesellschaftlichen Kompasses als Politik selbst begriffen, sich dem Rechtsrutsch nicht nur dienstbar machten, sondern diesen seit Jahren mit Macht betreiben. Da stehen wir nun. In Halle, in Deutschland. Alerta!“


Kommentar von Guido Kühn vom 17. Oktober 2026 bei Patreon.com

 

 – bitte komplett lesen!


Philosoph und Faschismusforscher Jason Stanley: „In Deutschland könnte es richtig schlimm werden. Schlimmer als in den Vereinigten Staaten.“ 


Im

Interview von Marc von Lüpke am 14. August 2026 auf t-online.de


 begründet der Faschismusforscher und Autor des Buches „Gefälschte Geschichte“, Jason Stanley, seine Sichtweise zur faschistischen Entwicklung:

„Eigentlich habe ich nur eine Furcht: Und zwar nicht genug gegen den Faschismus unternommen zu haben. Diesen Vorwurf möchte ich mir niemals machen müssen. In Deutschland solltet ihr aber wirklich Angst haben. (…) Aus den USA kennt man diese Videos, wie Migranten von ICE-Beamten aus Autos gezerrt werden und ihnen vor den Augen ihrer Kinder Handschellen angelegt werden. Das kann auch Deutschland blühen, hier kann es sogar noch übler werden. (…) Ja, das demokratische Deutschland hat aus der Geschichte gelernt, aber es hat die falschen Schlüsse gezogen. Der Faschismus …

gegen resignation, gegen streikende lehrer_innen

wieso nicht hier? wieso nicht jetzt? keinen Tag länger

Und das trifft sich gut, denn ich hatte es satt, den ganzen Tag eingesperrt zu sein, um in beschissenen Klassen vor Lehrern, die gar keine Lust haben, dort zu sein, Gehorsam zu lernen, um dann 50 Jahre meines Lebens damit zu verbringen, zu schuften, um den Kühlschrank zu füllen.

Und das ist gut so, denn die Mörsergranaten, die sie abbekommen haben, sind nur eine kleine Rache für die Gewalt, die der Staat uns antut – durch seine Kontrolle über unser Leben und seinen Umgang mit unseren Körpern und unserem Geist.


Und morgen?


Morgen hoffe ich, dass es wieder losgeht. Denn wenn wir uns entschliessen anzugreifen, durchbrechen wir die Monotonie und die Resignation. Wir nehmen unser Leben wieder selbst in die Hand und erheben uns gegen das, was uns beherrscht – ohne Mitläufer und ohne friedliche Reden.

title: Ruşen Yakut: Policies of impunity in femicide cases must end
content:
According to Ruşen Yakut of the Rosa Women’s Association, the growing number of femicides in Turkey and Kurdistan reflects a systematic, patriarchal structure of violence. Militarization, state repression, and impunity for perpetrators are exacerbating the situation, while state protection mechanisms frequently fail. In an interview with ANF, Yakut calls for a fundamental shift in policies concerning women, Turkey’s return to the Istanbul Convention, and the consistent criminal prosecution of violence against women.


“We are living through a period in which femicides are increasing dramatically. This violence has now reached the scale of systematic femicide,” Yakut said.


She identifies the patriarchal system itself as the root cause: “Militarism, which underpins nation-state structures, the growing emphasis on security, and the strengthening of sexist policies worldwide are further fueling violence against women.”


Yakut argues that the Turkish government’s policies are shaped by an authoritarian, nationalist, and sexist vision of society that undermines fundamental freedoms and social diversity. At the same time, the economic crisis, the growing prevalence of privately owned firearms, and the political climate are exacerbating violence.


“We are facing a reality in which women are murdered almost every day, either in their homes or on the streets, while children are subjected to attacks even in schools.”


https://1649452211.rsc.cdn77.org/20261017133358_2026-10-17-amed-rusen-yakut-rosa-kadin-dernegi-uyesi-kadin-katliamlari-ve-cezasizlik-politikasi-1.mp4


‘We do not want to be reduced to mere statistics or objects in news reports’


In response to the escalating violence and the lack of criminal prosecution, women’s organizations in Amed have come together to launch the “Women, Justice and Memory Vigil”. The ten-week campaign protests patriarchal government policies, impunity in femicide cases, and the concealment of suspicious deaths of women.


“We do not want to be reduced to mere statistics or objects in news reports,” Yakut emphasized. “Every murdered woman had dreams, children, plans for the future, and her own struggle for a life free from violence. We want to remember not only how they were murdered, but also the lives they fought to live.”


The vigil also aims to exert public pressure on the judiciary. Women’s organizations are demanding that perpetrators be identified, investigations be conducted effectively, and unexplained deaths be thoroughly investigated. According to Yakut, the initiative has already gained support beyond the participating organizations in its first few weeks. Men have also expressed solidarity without being specifically called upon to do so.


Visitors to the vigil frequently commemorate Rojin Kabaiş, Gülistan Doku, and Narin Güran. However, the initiative seeks to ensure that individual cases do not overshadow others. Instead, it aims to highlight the lives of women who have been murdered most recently each week.


“We wish we did not have to report a single femicide. Yet in the very first week, we had to commemorate eight murdered women, and in the second week, there were another eight,” Yakut said.


State protection mechanisms are failing


The women’s rights activist is particularly critical of the practices of judicial and security authorities. She stressed that existing protective measures are not consistently enforced, warning signs are ignored, and acts of violence are not prevented even when victims have previously sought help from state institutions.


“Even when a woman is murdered, we see that the system puts the woman, rather than the perpetrator, on trial,” Yakut said. She added that even in cases where the perpetrator’s identity is clear, sentence reductions for supposedly good behavior or penalties imposed at the lower end of the statutory range effectively create impunity.


“In cases of suspicious deaths, investigations are often inadequate. Case files are immediately closed with the designation ‘suicide’ or ‘accident.’ The cycle of violence behind these deaths and the failure of state institutions are not investigated,” she underlined.


Yakut pointed out that many murdered women had previously filed complaints, obtained protection orders, or submitted medical reports documenting the abuse they had suffered.


“We are talking about murders that unfolded in plain sight and could have been prevented,” Yakut said. Nevertheless, because authorities and public …

author: Chris Walker
title: Acton Says Ramaswamy Exploited Her Estranged Mother for Political Gain
content:
Ohio gubernatorial candidate Amy Acton accused her mother’s then-husband of sexual assault when she was a child.

Honest, paywall-free news is rare. Please support our boldly independent journalism with a donation of any size.

Democratic candidate for Ohio governor Amy Acton has responded to a political ad produced by her Republican opponent Vivek Ramaswamy’s campaign, which features her mother — whom she’s been estranged from for decades — describing Acton as a liar.

The ad is being widely criticized as distasteful because Acton accused her mother and her then-stepfather of abuse and sexual assault when she was just a child.

In the ad, Donna Arthur, Acton’s mother, is shown speaking directly into the camera about her daughter, whom she has not seen since 1978, when Acton was just 12 years old.

“Amy has a serious problem. She is a liar,” Arthur says. “She’s lied her entire life. My daughter needs help.”

The ad doesn’t mention why Arthur believes her daughter is a liar, and it leaves out all relevant information about their estrangement.

Acton alleges that she was the victim of sexual abuse by Arthur’s now-deceased husband when she was between the ages of 10 and 12. Acton has also recalled being unhoused at one point while living with her mother and stepfather.

She later told her father about the abuses, and a grand jury indicted her stepfather. Her mother and stepfather then fled the state to avoid prosecution, Acton has recounted.

The ad did not indicate who paid for or produced it. Though the Ramaswamy campaign had initially avoided taking responsibility for the ad, it has now admitted they made the commercial. What’s more, the campaign intends to spend an additional $4 million to continue airing it.

The campaign defended the ad in a statement.

“We don’t know what happened between Amy and her mother, who first spoke about Amy in 2020, but we know that Amy Acton is a serial fabulist who has some serious problems with the truth that the public needs to be aware of before deciding who to entrust as governor,” the Ramaswamy campaign said.

On Wednesday, Vice President JD Vance came to Ramaswamy’s defense.

“Whether the ad was appropriate or not is not really my concern,” Vance said in response to a reporter’s question, saying he was more focused on the election’s outcome.

“Have the opinion you want to have on that ad,” Vance continued, adding that he was “disgusted” at members of his own party “whining” about the contents of the ad.

Acton has condemned Ramaswamy for the ad in a statement posted on Facebook.

“Between the ages of 10 and 12, I was sexually abused by her husband, while my birth mother did nothing to protect me. … I’ve always known that she was deeply sick and unwell, and it’s sad to see Vivek Ramaswamy exploit her all for his own political gain,” Acton said.

I know what it feels like to be a child who is hungry, frightened, and uncertain of what tomorrow will bring. I know what it means to feel powerless and to depend on the courage and compassion of others to find a way forward. Those experiences shaped my values, my compassion, and my belief that every person deserves to be safe, to be heard, and to have a fair chance at a better life. They are part of what led me to become a doctor, to dedicate my life to public service, and to fight for people who too often feel forgotten or left behind.

Acton’s brother, Phillip Stearns, has also blasted the ad.

“It’s not surprising that Vivek Ramaswamy has stooped to such a despicable low as to attempt to turn the sexual abuse Amy endured at twelve years old from our birth mother’s husband into a political talking point,” Stearns said in a statement, adding that the commercial is a “desperate, disgusting attack” that “reveals exactly who Vivek Ramaswamy is at his core – a pathetic excuse for a man who is willing to hurt anyone as long as it gets him what he wants.”

The race between Acton, a physician and former director of the Ohio Department of Health, and Ramaswamy, an ally of President Donald Trump, is a tight one. According to an average of polling data compiled by FiftyPlusOne, Acton is currently leading the contest, garnering around 49 percent of support in the state, while Ramaswamy receives 44.5 percent.

author: Sue Bolton, Sarah Hathway
title: Socialist Alliance: ‘Stop weaponising shocking attack on Helen Haines MP’
content:
Socialist Alliance condemns the terrible attack on Helen Haines MP and we send our best wishes to her and her family.

This shocking incident had been politically weaponised even before the facts were established; the corporate media and some MPs went looking to find someone to blame.

The Zionists and right-wing commentators were quick to blame the pro-Palestine movement, because the alleged perpetrator — along with the majority of people in Australia — was critical of Israel’s genocide in Gaza. It has become stock in trade for mainstream media to brand critics of Israel as “extremist”.

We now know the alleged perpetrator suffered from poor mental health and that their family was friends with the Haines family.

As pressures mount around housing affordability and the rising cost of living, poorly resourced mental health services, especially in regional and rural Victoria, may contribute to anti-social behaviour.

The 2021 Royal Commission into Victoria’s Mental Health System made 65 recommendations and nine interim recommendations. These largely remain unfunded or not implemented, despite the Victorian Labor government promising to do so.

An independent report earlier this year made 270 sub-recommendations — only 54 have been fully implemented.

Right-wing influencers and the manosphere are also playing a role in influencing a layer of more vulnerable people to take on extreme and conspiracist views.

Data from Women for Election shows that online abuse towards those in elected positions is negatively impacting those in office, those running for office and those considering doing so. Just under 90% of women surveyed reported experiencing online abuse or intimidation connected to their political participation.

No one should be threatened or made to feel fear for themselves or their family members.

This attack on Haines is happening in the context of one woman a week being killed by a current or former partner in Australia. Despite advocacy and mass mobilisations to stop violence against women, misogyny is still pervasive.

Abuse and threats of violence towards women are also on the rise.

Pauline Hanson’s One Nation Party has been aggressively whipping up hate and division. Its scapegoating of vulnerable groups, based on ethnicity, religion, immigration status, gender and ability, as the “cause” of societal problems is part of the political context.

The major parties are contributing to this divisiveness, either through policy or rhetoric. This is being exacerbated by the mainstream media’s clickbait.

As a result, it is not just elected representatives who are being targeted with threats and violence; people are being emboldened by divisive politics to target already marginalised groups with racial, gendered or other violence.

There are solutions, but One Nation doesn’t have them. And while the major parties steal One Nations’ immigration policies, they help fuel the tinderbox atmosphere of fear and hate.

The mainstream parties pander to the extremist right, because it helps them divide and rule.

[Sue Bolton is a Socialist Alliance councillor on Merri-Bek City Council and is the Socialist Alliance candidate for Broadmeadows in the Victorian election. Sarah Hathway is a former City of Greater Geelong Councillor and the Socialist Alliance candidate for Lara in the Victorian election.]

title: Adli kontrol değil tedavisiz infaz: Hülya Gerçek’in ev hapsi
content:
Erkek şiddeti, istismar, taciz, tecavüz… Kadına yönelik her türlü şiddet… O kadar çok bunları konuşuyoruz, erkeklik suçları o kadar çok gündemimizi işgal ediyor ki ne yazık ki kadınlarla ilgili başkaca konuları konuşmaya imkan kalmıyor. Mesela kadın mahpuslar hatta biraz daha detaylandırayım, kadın hasta mahpuslar ve hatta ev hapsindeki kadın hasta mahpuslar.


Zaman zaman tartışırız: "Ev hapsindeyken deprem olsa ev hapsindeki kişi ne yapacak?" ya da "Ev hapsindeki kişi işe gidemediği için işten çıkarılır mı?" Peki ev hapsindeki kişi ağır bir hastalıkla mücadele ediyorsa ne olacak?


Mesela Hülya Gerçek… Üçüncü evre meme kanseri. Bu, kanserin meme dışına çıkarak çevre dokulara, göğüs duvarına veya koltuk altındaki lenf bezlerine yayıldığı ancak uzak organlara (kemik, karaciğer vb.) metastaz yapmadığı lokal ileri evreye ulaştığını gösteriyor.


Gerçek, 4 Mayıs 2025’te "örgüte finans sağlamak" iddiasıyla gözaltına alınıyor, ardından ev hapsi ile serbest bırakılıyor. Hasta bir kadın için bu pek de serbest bırakılma sayılmaz elbette.


Bu arada “örgüte finans sağlamak” ne demek derseniz? Şöyle, Türkiye'de terörizmin finansmanının önlenmesine dair esaslar

6415 sayılı Terörizmin Finansmanının Önlenmesi Hakkında Kanun

 ve

TCK m. 220 / Terörle Mücadele Kanunu (TMK)

 kapsamında düzenleniyor. 


Yani Gerçek’in durumunda olduğu gibi cezaevindeki bir yakına par göndermek de bu suçla ilişkilendiriliyor, ya da cezaevindeki yazarlara da telif ödemesi yapmak bu suçla ilişkilendiliyor. Evet evet. Ocak 2026’da K

or Kitap

’ın yayınevi temsilcisine, tutuklu yazar ve editörler Tonguç Ok ile Necip Baysal’a telif ödemesi yaptığı gerekçesiyle konutu terk etmeme (

ev hapsi

) şeklinde adli kontrol tedbiri uygulandı.


Benzer durumda olan ağır bir hasta mahpus Hatice Yıldız da var. Yıldız, cezaevinde tutuklu bulunan öz kızına ve kızının ihtiyaçlarını karşılayabilmesi için aynı koğuşta kalan arkadaşına PTT (Devlet Posta Kurumu) üzerinden resmi kanallarla para yatırdığı için de suçlanabiliyor. 


Bu arada hem cezaevindeki Yıldız’ın hem de GErçek’in tedavileri yarım kalıyor, bakımları yapılmıyor, kimi zaman tek kalıyorlar. 


Gerçek’in durumunda ise başka bir şaşırtıcı detay daha var, kendisi ile aynı dosyada tutulu olan diğer kişiler hakkında önce adli kontroller kaldırılıyor, ardından 2 Nisan’da hepsi beraat ediyor. Buna rağmen Hülya Gerçek hakkında uygulanan ev hapsi kaldırılmıyor. Bu da insanın aklına Gerçek’e yönelik başka özel bir öfke mi va sorusunu akıllara getiriyor? Neden?


Anayasa’nın 17. maddesi yaşam hakkını ve kişinin maddi ve manevi varlığını koruma hakkını, 56. maddesi ise herkesin sağlık hizmetlerinden yararlanma hakkını güvence altına alıyor. Avrupa İnsan Hakları Sözleşmesi’nin 2. ve 3. maddeleri uyarınca devletin yaşamı koruma ve insanlık dışı ya da onur kırıcı muameleyi önleme yükümlülüğü bulunuyor.


Birleşmiş Milletler Ekonomik, Sosyal ve Kültürel Haklar Sözleşmesi’nin 12. maddesi ise herkesin ulaşılabilir en yüksek sağlık standardına sahip olma hakkını tanıyor. 


En yalın hali ile Anayasa, yasalar ve uluslararası düzenlemelere rağmen Hülya Gerçek hakkında uygulanan adli kontrol tedbirinin devam ettirilmesi; ölçülülük, gereklilik ve orantılılık ilkeleriyle bağdaşmıyor. 


DEM Parti Milletvekili Çiçek Otlu, Adalet Bakanı Akın Gürlek'in yanıtlaması talebi ile 7 Ekim'de Gerçek'le ilgli bir soru önergesi sundu.  "Aynı dosya kapsamında tutuklu bulunan şüpheliler tahliye edildi diğer şüpheliler yönünden uygulanan adli kontrol tedbirleri kaldırıldı. 2 Nisan'da görülen karar duruşmasında dosya kapsamındaki tüm sanıklar hakkında beraat kararı verildi. Buna rağmen Hülya Gerçek hakkında uygulanan ev hapsi tedbirinin sürdürülmesi, hukuki değil keyfi bir uygulama izlenimi yaratmakta, eşitlik ilkesine ve adil yargılanma hakkına aykırılık oluşturuyor" dedi. 


1412 hasta mahpus 


Geçen hafta ise bu kez HDK Eş Sözcüsü / DEM Parti Erzurum Milletvekili ve Anayasa Komisyonu Üyesi Meral Danış Beştaş, Gerçek’in durumunu Meclis gündemine taşıdı. “Ağır veya kronik hastalığı bulunan kişiler hakkında konutu terk etmeme yükümlülüğü kararı verilirken sağlık durumunun, tedavi gereksinimlerinin ve hastaneye erişim imkânlarının değerlendirilmesine ilişkin Bakanlığınızca belirlenmiş bir usul, kriter veya genelge bulunuyor mu?” diye sordu.

author: Ridah Hassan
title: Manosphere making classrooms toxic
content:
“I had male students threatening to rape the female students consistently. They would play ‘rape marry kill’ and used my own name frequently in their ‘game’.”

“Students saying ‘good girl’ to teachers.”

“Less respect for female staff vs male in behaviour—even with the same approaches they instantly listen to males more. More inappropriate jokes—racism, homophobic and sexist jokes with little consequences. Visible [and] audible dismissal/rejection of female staff to their faces when they appear to take classes.” 

These are quotes from a Monash University report which has cast light on the disturbing sexist conditions faced by teachers and students in primary and secondary schools across the country. 

Duty of Care: Teachers’ experiences of sexism, misogyny and sexual harassment in Australian schools

 is based on the testimony of 2,600 educators and reveals the breadth and depth of the crisis. 

A common theme in the report is the lack of respect male students show female teachers. This includes frequent interrupting, ignoring of instructions, mocking and mimicking, speaking disrespectfully and refusing to accept responsibility when challenged about inappropriate behaviour. Physical aggression and intimidation were also reported, along with threats of more serious physical and sexual assault. Male students frequently make “derogatory comments toward females focusing on appearance and worth”, “jokes about gender roles e.g. the kitchen”, “inappropriate sexualised remarks about female bodies, including specifically about peers and/or staff” and “[making] sexual noises in the classroom” while female staff are trying to teach.

This behaviour is contributing to the burn-out of teachers in a profession already facing shortages due to poor pay and unmanageable workloads. One respondent put it clearly: “Being the front line and bearing the brunt of misogyny is exhausting and erodes self-worth”. According to the report, 77 percent of teachers say that sexism and misogyny have a “negative” or “very negative” impact on their wellbeing, and more than 50 percent of female teachers report that they either “occasionally” or “frequently” consider leaving the profession because of it. And the situation is getting worse—both primary and secondary teachers reported that gendered violence on the part of students had increased significantly in the previous twelve months.

Given adult teachers are feeling undermined, threatened and belittled by male students’ behaviour, the impact on teenage girls should be cause for immediate action. According to the report, “Younger students are comfortable using misogynistic language without thought e.g. calling girls in class a ‘slut’ ‘whore’ because they won’t share a highlighter”, and “Women/girls in class are okay with being treated with misogyny as this is seen as ‘normal’ now. They do not retaliate and internalise, making emotional regulation hard”. Another teacher observed: “Female students are scared to speak out and express their opinions in class with males who chastise them. I am noticing students are very hesitant to participate in discussion these days whereas it used to be female students being quite eager to share ideas and answer questions. Female students appear angrier than in the past as well”.

Male students direct sexist and misogynistic language towards their female peers freely, entrenching a toxic gender divide among students. Again, the statistics bear this out, with 80 percent of respondents agreeing that the behaviour is having a negative impact on student wellbeing. In observing and being victim to male students’ sexism—including constantly disrupting learning and making spaces hostile—girls are being socialised to accept dehumanising language and treatment and to make themselves small targets by withdrawing and accommodating to the selfish and anti-social behaviour of boys. 

And though there are undoubtedly some who are willing to challenge their peers’ appalling behaviour, it is an unacceptable environment for female students to be expected to navigate every day, while at the same time trying to do the actual tasks of deciphering Shakespeare or learning calculus. It is well established that students learn best when they feel safe, supported and respected. This is currently not the case for female students at Australian schools.

author: Eliel Peterson
title: Death as liberation
content:
Death as liberation is hardly a comfortable political proposition to digest. In a world where Black death is often the common condition, there is a well-established insistence on our living. So what do we make of two of Africa’s greatest filmmakers, Ousmane Sembène and Souleymane Cissé, whose earliest cinematic visions, expressed through their respective debut features

Black Girl

 (1966) and

Den Muso

 (1975), center on the suffering, alienation, and eventual deaths of Black women?

Sembène’s

Black Girl

 is preoccupied with racial violence and the economic exploitation that continues to structure relations between Senegal and France. The film follows Diouana, a young Senegalese woman who accepts employment with a white French family and travels to Antibes believing she is embarking on a new life. While Cissé’s

Den Muso

, turns inward, examining interpersonal violence and the ways patriarchal power consumes family life and communities, weakening the broader social fabric of a nation. The film follows Tenin, a mute young woman who becomes pregnant after being raped, exposing the brutal underbelly of the patriarchal violence imposed upon her. Despite the differences in their circumstances, both films position death as a troubling possibility of liberation for their central characters.

Tenin (Dounamba Dany Coulibaly) in a still from Souleymane Cissé’s

Den Muso

 (1975).

The history of Black resistance has not solely been confined to the preservation of life. From enslaved Africans who leapt from ships during the Middle Passage, to those who faced death in the fight against their oppression,

It is true

 that to rather die than to endure is not a popular or digestible form of liberation. Although these acts are not equivalent, nor do they carry the same weight as the deaths of these fictional characters, Sembène and Cissé, raise an uncomfortable question: what does life mean for a person stripped of agency, recognition, and self-determination?

For Diouana and Tenin, freedom remains out of reach because of the structures governing their everyday lives that continually deny these women full humanity: Tenin’s father and her rapist, Diouana’s white employers. This sustained stripping of humanity produces what I would argue is already a death, albeit a social one, that precedes their physical endings. Sembène and Cissé challenge audiences by asking what is living for the dehumanized. Diouana travels to France only to find her livelihood replaced by isolation and unpaid, alienated labor, while Tenin’s body becomes a site upon which familial and communal shame, punishment, and control are dumped. Death, therefore, is at the core of both films from the outset, existing not only as a shocking culminating event, but as a condition of violence. By the end of each film, Sembène and Cissé are not arguing over whether death is a worthy or noble choice for self-liberation; rather, they position the act of self-annihilation as the only remaining form of control available to their characters, and as an indictment of a society in which death is the only option. 

It is understandable to recoil at the self-inflicted violence that ultimately claims both Diouana and Tenin. One might ask why their rage is not directed solely towards those who harmed them. Why does Tenin’s retaliation extend beyond her rapist? Why doesn’t Diouana exact revenge on her employers and flee France? These questions linger because death feels like an unsatisfying conclusion, one that denies us, as audiences, the catharsis of resistance. We want these women to fight back and survive. We want their suffering to lead somewhere other than death. Yet perhaps the more daunting question is not why these women die, but whether we find their deaths more difficult to accept than the suffering that precedes them. What is ultimately more uncomfortable to confront: their deaths, or the conditions that made life itself unbearable?

Neither film offers an uncomplicated answer. To read Diouana’s and Tenin’s deaths as acts of liberation is not to suggest that their deaths resolve the violence they endure, or that self-annihilation is freedom in any complete sense. Their deaths do not dismantle the structures that dehumanized them. What death offers these women, perhaps then, is not freedom but a final assertion of agency within those systems. This is what makes their endings so devastating: the possibility of control emerges only when the possibility of living on their …

author: Chris Walker
title: Prosecutors Filed Over 900 Cases of “Pregnancy-Related Crimes” Since Dobbs
content:
Most of the charges being brought stem from laws that were never meant to apply to pregnancy.

Truthout is an indispensable resource for activists, movement leaders and workers everywhere. Please make this work possible with a quick donation.

A new report has found that, in the years following the Supreme Court’s overturning of abortion rights established in Roe v. Wade, hundreds of people have been charged with crimes related to their pregnancies.

Reproductive rights nonprofit Pregnancy Justice documented at least 902 cases of such charges in the three years after the court’s Dobbs v. Jackson Women’s Health decision. The data suggests that more cases likely exist, since the research only covers the period from the summer of 2022 through 2025, and doesn’t include instances where people were charged over the past year.

Most of the charges being brought against pregnant people relate to their actions while pregnant, pregnancy loss, or births, Pregnancy Justice noted in its report. The cases are primarily based on long-existing criminal statutes, not new abortion ban laws, with 876 of the 955 charges documented relating to allegations of child neglect, endangerment, or abuse.

While the report notes that 23 states charged people with pregnancy-related crimes during that three-year period, a majority of the cases were in just three states — South Carolina (381 cases), Oklahoma (222), and Alabama (204).

These charges included claims from prosecutors that individuals were abusing drugs or other substances during their pregnancies; failed to provide an adequate amount of prenatal care for their fetus or infant; and attempted to obtain, obtained, or even merely researched abortion services.

What’s more, prosecutors overwhelmingly charged pregnant people under statutes that allow them to obtain convictions without proving that there was any actual harm to a fetus or infant. According to the report, close to 95 percent of the cases involved such charges.

“These numbers show that the criminalization of pregnancy in this country is not some distant or hypothetical consequence of abortion bans,” said Lourdes A. Rivera, president of Pregnancy Justice. “It is already happening.”

Law enforcement is using laws that were never intended to apply to pregnancy to investigate, arrest, and punish women, and it’s only getting worse since the overturning of Roe. Pregnant people deserve health care, support, and dignity — not handcuffs.

Beyond criminal charges that pregnant people have faced, abortion bans and other restrictions on reproductive health care have also led to deadly outcomes in the years since the Dobbs decision.

A ProPublica report from last month, for example, found around 200 documented instances of people dying from ectopic pregnancies from 2020-2025 — a rate that is about double what it had been in the preceding six-year period.

The report noted that doctors, perhaps concerned that their action could be viewed as illegal by their state governments, may be hesitating to offer treatment when an ectopic pregnancy occurs. Such pregnancies, in which a fertilized egg implants outside the uterus, often in a fallopian tube, are in no way viable and can often lead to life-threatening complications.

In an op-ed for Truthout in the spring of 2025, Lauren Rankin, reproductive rights author and journalist, wrote: “Under abortion bans, the life of the pregnant person is a secondary concern.”

“Doctors are afraid of being prosecuted for treating a potentially life-threatening health issue; someone facing a miscarriage is afraid of being prosecuted for flushing the toilet; and a teenager and her mother were imprisoned because she didn’t know where else to turn for an abortion in her state,” Rankin said, discussing real-life examples of how abortion restrictions have detrimentally affected people’s lives.

“This isn’t an accident, but an intentional byproduct of overturning Roe and ending the constitutional right to an abortion,” Rankin added. “Ending Roe was meant to ripple far beyond abortion — it was meant to erode the personhood of pregnant people, to eradicate their full-fledged autonomy and ability to determine the course of their own lives. When you reduce someone to less than a person in the eyes of the state, criminalization is never far behind.”

Truthout is one of only a few platforms for justice-oriented, grassroots journalism. Today, we face an existential threat.

author: CMI Argentina
title: Neuquén: jurado popular encontró culpable a Roberto Sánchez por el transfemicidio de Azul Semeñenko
content:
Un jurado popular declaró culpable a Roberto Daniel Sánchez por el homicidio de Azul Semeñenko, triplemente agravado por ensañamiento, odio a su identidad de género y mediado por violencia de género. Se trató de un juicio histórico en la provincia de Neuquén, que se desarrolló a lo largo de 12 audiencias y contó con más de 30 testimonios.


Escuchar el reporte de La Revuelta y Periodistas Feministas


Durante las jornadas, compañeras de trabajo de Azul, organizaciones feministas, integrantes de la comunidad LGBTIQ+ y organizaciones sociales acompañaron el proceso. En la última audiencia, estuvieron presentes con un altar en homenaje a Azul, carteles y música.


Tras conocerse el veredicto, su hermano,

Marco Millapán

, destacó el acompañamiento colectivo y la importancia de la decisión judicial.

“La verdad que haber conseguido este veredicto del jurado popular es fruto colectivo de cada uno de los que hoy están presentes y de los que nos han venido acompañando a lo largo de todo este año”

, expresó.


“Logramos lo que todos queríamos, justicia por y para Azul. Esto fue un transfemicidio, esto fue un crimen de odio”

, afirmó.


Por su parte, el fiscal jefe

Agustín García

 señaló que el juicio implicó un importante desafío por la cantidad y complejidad de las pruebas presentadas.

“Fue un juicio en donde había mucha información, muchos testigos, muchos peritos. Había que trabajarlo de tal modo que toda esa prueba fuera bien comprendida por el jurado, en el contexto en que se dan las cosas, acá no se puede aislar hechos individuales sin contextualizarlo”

, explicó.


García también remarcó la relevancia del reconocimiento de las agravantes:

“El primer caso en Neuquén, en donde desde la reforma del año 2012 se juzga a una persona con estas agravantes, era un desafío también para nosotros”

.


El homicidio ocurrió durante la madrugada del 25 de septiembre de 2025 dentro de la vivienda de Sánchez, situada en la ciudad de Neuquén. De acuerdo con la acusación, dentro de la casa Sánchez atacó a Azul con golpes realizados con elementos contundentes y con un arma blanca. La autopsia confirmó que la víctima recibió 25 heridas de arma blanca.


Desde la querella valoraron el veredicto como un alivio para la familia, después de atravesar un largo proceso en busca de justicia.

“Hoy es una brisa también que alivia un poco el fuego en el que se viven las injusticias, como venía viviendo la familia hasta este día”

, expresaron.


Además, remarcaron que la decisión del jurado debe generar una reflexión social:

“Declararon que fue un transfemicidio, pero esto tiene que construir también un aprendizaje a nuestra comunidad. Azul no nos la devuelven, pero Azul tiene que ser la última”

.


Tras la declaración de culpabilidad de Sánchez, se espera que en los próximos días se realice la audiencia de determinación de la pena.

author: TGEU
title: Hungary removes anti-LGBTI provisions, but trans people are still left out
content:
TGEU welcomes the decision of the Hungarian National Assembly on 13 October, 2026 to remove the anti-LGBTI content from the 2021 ‘child protection’ law. This is a necessary step to implement the Court of Justice of the EU (CJEU) judgment in

Commission v Hungary

 (C-769/22).


In its April 2026 judgment, the CJEU found that the law, which stigmatised LGBTI people under the guise of child protection, breached EU law. It also rejected Hungary’s reliance on national identity to justify discriminatory measures. 


Why this matters for trans people


The ruling matters for trans people across the EU, because it confirms that Member States cannot use ‘child protection’ or national identity as an excuse for excluding trans and other LGBTI people from public life and the rights EU law guarantees them. The CJEU has already held in

Mirin

 (C-4/23) that Member States must recognise a legal gender change obtained in another Member State, so the Commission has clear legal grounds to act. The CJEU has also held in

Deldits

 (C-247/23) that a Hungarian refusal to rectify a trans refugee’s gender marker breaches the GDPR, which further strengthens the case for Commission action.


The reality of LGBTI rights in Hungary


However, compliance with EU law and European human rights standards remains incomplete. Hungary’s Fundamental Law (its constitution) continues to enshrine a rigid gender binary just like in

Slovakia

, and Hungary still bans legal gender recognition. Since 2020, trans and intersex people in Hungary have been unable to have their gender legally recognised, with serious consequences for daily life, access to services and personal safety.


Our call to action


TGEU calls on the European Commission to pressure Hungary, as well as Slovakia, to amend their constitutions in order to remove the forced gender binary. Both countries must also establish quick, transparent and accessible legal gender recognition procedures that comply with EU and ECHR (European Court of Human Rights) standards.


Your support makes change possible


We work across Europe and Central Asia to advance trans rights, build strong communities, and drive change through research, advocacy, and community-building.


Your donation helps us continue this vital work — defending trans lives, amplifying trans voices, and advocating for justice every day.

title: Έκτακτη συγκέντρωση στις γυναικείες φυλακές Κορυδαλλού, Τετάρτη 21/10, στις 18.00
content:
“Την τρίτη 20/10 αυτοκτόνησε μια κρατούμενη στις γυναικείες φυλακές Κορυδαλλού, η δεύτερη τους τελευταίους 4 μήνες. Καλούμε σε συγκέντρωση έξω από το κολαστήριο των γυναικείων φυλακών Κορυδαλλού την Τετάρτη 21/10 στις 18:00”


Καλέσματα:


Συνέλευση αλληλεγγύης στους φυλακισμένους, φυγόδικους και διωκόμενους αγωνιστές και αγωνίστριες


[Έκτακτο] Τετάρτη 21/10 στις 18:00 συγκέντρωση έξω από το κολαστήριο των γυναικείων φυλακών Κορυδαλλού


Την τρίτη 20/10 αυτοκτόνησε μια κρατούμενη στις γυναικείες φυλακές Κορυδαλλού, η δεύτερη τους τελευταίους 4 μήνες. Καλούμε σε συγκέντρωση έξω από το κολαστήριο των γυναικείων φυλακών Κορυδαλλού την Τετάρτη 21/10 στις 18:00


Καλούμε σε συγκέντρωση έξω από το κολαστήριο των γυναικείων φυλακών Κορυδαλλού την Τετάρτη 21/10 στις 18:00


Οι ζωές των κρατουμένων μετράνε


Την τρίτη 20/10 αυτοκτόνησε μια κρατούμενη στις γυναικείες φυλακές Κορυδαλλού, η δεύτερη τους τελευταίους 4 μήνες. Οι διαρκής υποτιμηση των ζώων των κρατουμένων, οι άθλιες συνθήκες διαβίωσης, η έλλειψη ιατροφαρμακευτικής περίθαλψης, το απάνθρωπο βάρος του εγκλεισμού και ο υπερπληθυσμός των κρατουμένων είναι μόνο λίγα από όσα μπορούμε να αναφέρουμε για αυτά τα κολαστήρια. Σε μία συνθήκη που το κράτος επενδύει σε νέες φυλακές, συνεχίζει να θεωρεί τους φυλακισμένους/ες αναλωσιμους/ες αδιαφορώντας για την ανθρώπινη ύπαρξη. Κανενας θάνατος μέσα στις φυλακές δεν θα μείνει αναπάντητος.


Όλοι/ες/α αύριο στην συγκέντρωση έξω από τις φυλακές για να δείξουμε ότι για μας οι ζωές των κρατουμένων έχουν αξία. Δεν συνηθίζουμε τον θάνατο. Μέχρι την καταστροφή και του τελευταίου κελιού.


Δύναμη και αλληλεγγύη στις έγκλειστες.


Καμία μόνη στα χέρια του κράτους


Ταμείο αλληλεγγύης φυλακισμένων και διωκόμενων αγωνιστών/τριών


[Έκτακτο] Κάλεσμα στις γυναικείες φυλακές κορυδαλλού Τετάρτη 21 Οκτώβρη 18:00


Σήμερα, 20 Οκτώβρη, μια ακόμα κρατούμενη αυτοκτονεί στα κελιά της δημοκρατίας και εντοπίζεται από τις συγκρατούμενές της, μεταξύ των οποίων και οι τρεις συντρόφισσες που βρίσκονται στον Κορυδαλλό. Μια ακόμα σκληρή προσθήκη στη μακρά λίστα κρατουμένων που έχασαν τη ζωή τους στις ελληνικές φυλακές. Πρώτο μέλημα της διεύθυνσης στο άκουσμα αυτής της ανατριχιαστικής είδησης, είναι να απειλήσει με πειθαρχικά σε περίπτωση κινητοποιήσεων εντός της φυλακής.


Ενάντια σε αυτή τη βαρβαρότητα και το σύστημα που τη γεννά, τη συντηρεί και την απολαμβάνει, ως ελάχιστη ένδειξη αλληλεγγύης στις κρατούμενες,

καλούμε αύριο συγκέντρωση στον Κορυδαλλό 18:00.


ΜΕΧΡΙ ΤΟ ΓΚΡΕΜΙΣΜΑ ΚΑΙ ΤΗΣ ΤΕΛΕΥΤΑΙΑΣ ΦΥΛΑΚΗΣ


ΜΠΟΥΡΛΟΤΟ ΚΑΙ ΦΩΤΙΑ ΣΕ ΟΛΑ ΤΑ ΚΕΛΙΑ


Ανοιχτή Συνέλευση Αλληλεγγύης στους/ις διωκόμενους/ες για την απαλλοτρίωση τράπεζας στην Κάτω Τιθορέα


[ΕΚΤΑΚΤΟ] Συγκέντρωση στις γυναικείες φυλακές Κορυδαλλού – Τετάρτη 21/10 στις 18:00


Στις 20/10 αυτοκτονεί κρατούμενη στο Κατάστημα Κράτησης Κορυδαλλού ΙΙ. Κρατούμενες συμπεριλαμβανομένων και των 3 συντροφισσών που κρατούνται εκεί, την βρίσκουν κρεμασμένη στο μπάνιο. Η διεύθυνση της φυλακής σε μια προσπάθεια να αποτρέψει τις κινητοποιήσεις απειλεί με πειθαρχικά.


Τέσσερις μόλις μήνες μετά την αυτοκτονία κρατούμενης εντός του Κέντρου Κράτησης Κορυδαλλού ΙΙ, ένας ακόμη θάνατος μπαίνει σε μια τεράστια λίστα από κρατούμενους/ες που έχουν χάσει την ζωή τους μέσα σε κέντρα κράτησης και φυλακές. Το αδηφάγο σύστημα της φυλακής με τα πιόνια που το στηρίζουν, απειλούν, βασανίζουν και καλύπτουν αυτοκτονίες στο όνομα ενός σωφρονισμού που υπάρχει μόνο στα διεστραμένα μυαλά τους. Ψυχολογική επιβάρυνση, στοχοποίηση όσων στέκονται απέναντι στην απαξίωση της ζωής, καταπάτηση της αξιοπρέπειας είναι μόνο μερικά από τα όσα αποπειρώνται τα υπαλληλάκια της καταστολής.


Μπορούν να κρυφτούν πίσω από κάμερες ασφαλείας, τοίχους και στολές όσο θέλουν. Η οργή μας θα τους πνίξει όπως το ποτάμι πνίγει τους αφρούς του. Ας έχει υπόψιν η διευθύντρια των φυλακών ότι οι συντρόφισσες μας δεν είναι μόνες και οποιαδήποτε απειλή δε θα μείνει αναπάντητη.


ΟΙ ΖΩΕΣ ΤΩΝ ΚΡΑΤΟΥΜΕΝΩΝ ΜΕΤΡΑΝΕ


ΚΑΜΙΑ ΜΟΝΗ ΣΤΑ ΧΕΡΙΑ ΤΟΥ ΚΡΑΤΟΥΣ
