title: Apelaron el fallo que benefició a los prefectos del grupo Albatros que mataron al joven mapuche Rafael Nahuel
content:
En septiembre pasado, la Cámara Federal de Casación Penal hizo lugar a las defensas y redujo la condena de los cinco integrantes de la agrupación Albatros de Prefectura Naval Argentina que formaron parte del operativo que dio muerte a Rafael Nahuel en el marco del conflicto de Villa Mascardi, Río Negro. Frente a esa medida, los padres del joven fallecido representados por el abogado Rubén Marigo, referente de la Asamblea Permanente por los Derechos Humanos (APDH), interpusieron un recurso extraordinario.


En la presentación Marigo expone que la decisión dada a conocer el mes pasado modifica “sustancialmente las penas impuestas a los condenados, disponiéndose además su ejecución condicional y dejándose sin efecto las penas de inhabilitación especial”. Tal determinación causa a los padres de Rafael Nahuel “un gravamen federal, actual e irreparable”.


Cabe recordar que el 25 de noviembre de 2017, dos días después del violento desalojo de la comunidad, Rafael Nahuel fue a la lof lafken Winkul Mapu en Villa Mascardi para llevar ayuda, alimentos y abrigo a los jóvenes que habían logrado escapar de las balas, y fue sorprendido por una patrulla de la Prefectura que le disparó por la espalda mientras huía. Los cinco prefectos del grupo Albatros fueron condenados tras el juicio oral que culminó en noviembre de 2023. Sergio Cavia recibió 5 años de prisión e inhabilitación por homicidio agravado cometido con exceso en la legítima defensa, en tanto a Francisco Javier Pintos, Juan Ramón Obregón, Carlos Valentín Sosa y Sergio García les dieron una pena de 4 años y 6 meses de prisión como partícipes necesarios.


El abogado expone en el texto que en cambio el fallo de Cámara, que la familia apeló redujo la pena de Cavia a tres años de prisión, de Obregón, dos años y seis meses de prisión, de Pintos y Sosa a dos años y tres meses de prisión, de García a dos años de prisión; todas de penas de prisión en suspenso. De tal forma, el abogado Marigo indicó que ese fallo “modifica sustancialmente la respuesta punitiva establecida respecto de los condenados”, incluso “disponiendo su ejecución condicional”. Asimismo, remarca que quedaron “sin efecto las penas de inhabilitación especial”.


Marigo sostuvo que “la resolución recurrida produce, de este modo, una modificación sustancial de la decisión adoptada por el tribunal de juicio respecto de la respuesta penal correspondiente a los hechos por los cuales los imputados fueron condenados, afectando de manera directa los derechos e intereses de mis mandantes en su carácter de querellantes y familiares de la víctima”.


El abogado de la familia de Rafael Nahuel cuestionó la arbitrariedad del razonamiento empleado por la sentencia recurrida para apartarse de la valoración efectuada por el Tribunal Oral Federal de General Roca. A su criterio, “la participación necesaria de Pintos, Obregón, Sosa y García y la plataforma fáctica sobre la que ella fue establecida permanecían incólumes, la reducción de las penas exigía una fundamentación que demostrara concretamente la arbitrariedad de la valoración efectuada por el Tribunal Oral, y no solamente una ponderación distinta de los mismos elementos”.


En cuanto a haber dejado sin efecto la inhabilitación especial, el abogado subrayó que esa determinación “no constituía una sanción desvinculada del hecho juzgado, sino una pena directamente relacionada con la condición funcional de los condenados y con la utilización de armas reglamentarias en el marco de una actuación estatal que culminó con la muerte de Rafael Nahuel. Se trata, por ello, de una sanción que adquiere particular relevancia frente a un hecho de violencia institucional y que debía ser examinada atendiendo precisamente a la función pública en cuyo ejercicio se produjo el hecho”.


Frente a esa consideración, indica: “Sin embargo, la sentencia recurrida utiliza como fundamento para excluir la inhabilitación circunstancias tales como la ausencia de antecedentes, las buenas condiciones personales y la realización de cursos de capacitación para el servicio público, sin explicar por qué esos mismos elementos resultan suficientes para neutralizar la necesidad de impedir que los condenados continúen ejerciendo funciones vinculadas con el empleo de armas estatales”.

author: CMI Argentina
title: Con los cambios que impulsaba la oposición, Diputados aprobó la nueva Ley de Fortalecimiento al Sistema de Discapacidad
content:
El proyecto obtuvo media sanción con 237 votos a favor, tras forzar a La Libertad Avanza a garantizar fondos frente al ajuste de Caputo. Incompatibilidades blindadas, plazos para saldar deudas con prestadores y el rechazo de los cordobeses alineados al oficialismo.


Foto: Pablo Lecaros


En una sesión de alta intensidad y tras más de cuatro horas de discusión, la Cámara de Diputados de la Nación le dio media sanción al proyecto de Ley de Fortalecimiento del Sistema de Discapacidad. La iniciativa cosechada en el recinto arrojó un contundente resultado de 237 votos afirmativos, 9 negativos y 4 abstenciones, logrando un consenso transversal que ahora deberá ser revalidado en el Senado. Sin embargo, la amplia ventaja numérica no opacó la trastienda de una negociación donde los bloques de la oposición dialoguista y el peronismo obligaron al oficialismo a modificar el texto original para blindar partidas frente al Presupuesto 2027.


El dictamen definitivo, impulsado formalmente por La Libertad Avanza tras aceptar modificaciones de la oposición, funcionó como un dique de contención frente a los recortes planteados por la Casa Rosada.


Lo que se mantiene de la ley de emergencia es, por ejemplo, la compatibilidad entre el goce de una pensión contributiva por discapacidad (70% del haber jubilatorio mínimo) para titulares del CUD y tener un empleo formal o monotributo, siempre y cuando los ingresos no superen los dos salarios mínimos vitales y móviles.


Además se mantiene el principio de nomenclador único, se ratifica la indexación automática periódica de los aranceles de las prestaciones por el índice de movilidad jubilatoria (atado al IPC), y se garantiza la cobertura básica de protección médica del Plan Federal Incluir Salud para quienes tengan la pensión por discapacidad.


En cuanto al financiamiento, se establece que la asignación presupuestaria del Ministerio de Salud no podrá ser inferior en términos reales al ejercicio fiscal del año anterior.


Por otro lado, se crea un sistema de auditorías periódicas con cruce de datos de ANSES, ARCA, SINTyS y RENAPER bajo el principio del debido proceso inclusivo.


Y se incorporó a pedido de aliados una cláusula transitoria que exige un cronograma para el pago de las compensaciones atrasadas a prestadores, con un plazo máximo de 30 días para la reglamentación del Poder Ejecutivo.


Durante toda la jornada, los referentes de Unión por la Patria se juntaron durante horas con representantes de colectivos de discapacidad para discutir con ellos la posibilidad de confluir con el oficialismo en el dictamen de mayoría en lugar de seguir aferrándose a la prórroga de la emergencia hasta el 31 de diciembre del 2027.

title: Thousands commemorate 69 fallen guerrilla fighters in Kobanê
content:
Thousands of people from various cities across Rojava gathered in Kobanê to commemorate 69 members of the People’s Defense Forces (HPG) and the Free Women’s Troops (YJA Star) who lost their lives in the Kurdish freedom struggle over the years. Relatives of the fallen fighters, along with representatives of political parties and civil society organizations, attended the commemoration at the Şehîd Dicle Cemetery. The ceremony began with a minute of silence, followed by the reading of the names of the 69 guerrilla fighters.


Mustafa Êto, co-chair of the Council of War Veterans and Families of the Martyrs in Kobanê, paid tribute to the deceased fighters’ commitment to a democratic and just society.


“Our martyrs waged a historic struggle under all circumstances. Sixty-nine names also mean sixty-nine mothers. We will remain committed to their cause until the end,” he declared.


https://1649452211.rsc.cdn77.org/20261021141322_2026-10-21-kobane-hpg-yja-star-ozgurluk-gerillari-icin-duzenlenen-taziye-toreni-1.mp4


‘We will strengthen our resistance and organization’


Xerîb Hiso, co-chair of the Democratic Union Party (PYD), also commemorated the fallen fighters and their significance for the joint struggle of the peoples of Syria. He said they had stood against genocide, denial, and annihilation, dedicating their lives to freedom and democracy.


“We promise to further strengthen our struggle, our resistance, and the organization of our society. This is our promise to the martyrs,” Hiso said. He noted that Kurds, Arabs, and Turkmen were among those who had lost their lives. “These fallen fighters are a bridge between peace and resistance.”


Rûken Ehmed, a member of the coordination committee of the women’s movement Kongra Star in Kobanê, highlighted the significance of the decades-long guerrilla struggle for Kurdish society. She emphasized that preserving the gains achieved required defending the legacy of the martyrs.


Joint commemoration by different communities


Speaking on behalf of the Arab community, the father of fallen fighter Şahin Ereb said: “On behalf of the Arab community, I extend my condolences to you all. I am just as proud as you are. We are all united as one.”


Representatives of the Syrian Kurdish Democratic Party and the Council of Religions and Faith Communities of Kobanê also addressed the gathering.


Xalid Yûsif Xelef, speaking on behalf of the Cizîrê region, recalled Kobanê’s history of resistance.


“Today, we are in the city of Kobanê, which made history and declared: ‘We will never abandon this city.’ The 69 resistance fighters went to the free mountains and fell in a heroic struggle.”


At the conclusion of the ceremony, the commemorative certificates honoring the 69 fallen fighters were read aloud and presented to their families.

title: Prochaines initiations médic du collectif Soin Collectif Île-de-France
content:
Rendez-vous ce soir à 18h30 au cinéma la Clef salle 2 (34 rue Daubenton), et samedi matin au Baranoux (horaire à venir). Formation à prix libre d'environ 2h sur les bases du secourisme en manif, les armes de la police, et reconnaître les signes de gravité. Par

Soin Collectif Idf


Au programme :


 Être médic


 Qui peut être médic

 Protéger, rassurer, respecter le consentement

 Les armes et les blessures


 Les armes de la répression

 Plaies, brûlures et traumas

 Quand c'est grave


 Reconnaître la gravité

 Obtenir l'intervention des secours


Ce soir à la Clef : 64 places disponibles, en sous-sol, non accessible

PMR


Qui

 

?


Soin Collectif Île-de-France est un collectif de street-médics horizontal, indépendant et inclusif, basé à Paris et ses alentours.


Nous sommes avant tout des militant-e-s et participons dès lors à toute manifestation ou rassemblement qui correspondent à nos valeurs. Nous avons créé ce collectif afin de nous organiser entre personnes pratiquant la médic, de mettre en commun nos connaissances, et de faire connaître nos pratiques. Nous ne prétendons pas parler au nom de l'ensemble de nos membres ni diriger leurs actions.


Certain-es d'entre nous sommes professionnel-les ou volontaires du secteur de la santé et du secourisme, mais pas toustes : nos pratiques sont régulièrement différenciées de celles du soin institutionnel.


Nos valeurs


Nous nous revendiquons anarchistes, antifascistes, féministes, antiracistes, dévalidistees et révolutionanires. Nous ne sommes pas apolitiques : nous luttons aux côtés de celles et ceux qui se battent contre les réactionnaires et les oppressions, où qu'elles soient.


Nous nous positionnons contre les tendances virilistes que l'on peut trouver dans certains milieux médic (posture de mise en avant de soi, prise de risques inutiles, prise d'ascendant sur les autres).


Nos pratiques


Nous proposons notre aide à toute personne en ayant besoin, tout en prenant soin de préserver notre propre intégrité. Nous ne demandons pas de compensation, sous quelque forme que ce soit, y compris symbolique (nous nous opposons à l'héroïsation de la figure du médic).


Nous respectons le consentement des personnes prises en charge dans nos pratiques de soin. Nous avons pour volonté de lutter contre toute forme de discrimination, y compris et surtout dans nos propres milieux.


Nous sommes honnêtes vis-à-vis de nos compétences, nous nous efforçons de nous maintenir au niveau, d'apprendre, et d'approfondir les connaissances que nous avons afin d'apporter la meilleure aide à nos camarades.


Conscient-es de nos limites nous ne réalisons pas d'actes pour lesquels nous n'avons pas été formé-es afin de ne pas mettre en danger supplémentaire la personne secourue.


Nous contacter


Mail : medics-deter-idf [at] proton.me


On se soigne, on s'organise, on se défend

author: Nehaa Bimal
title: ‘We want closure’: 1 year after Joshua Qiyuk’s death, family still seeking answers
content:
It’s been one year since Joshua Qiyuk was found stabbed to death in Ottawa, and his mother is still asking the same questions.


“I want to find out why, who did it,” Brenda Qiyuk said in an interview Monday, three days before the one-year-anniversary of her son’s death.


Joshua Qiyuk, a 21-year-old Inuk man from Baker Lake, was

found dead

 on Oct. 22, 2025, in Ottawa’s Manor Park neighbourhood.


The city’s police service is still investigating his death. No arrests have been made, said police spokesperson Julie Kavanagh Tuesday in an email.


“We want closure,” Brenda said. “My son’s killer hasn’t been found yet. Where did this killer go? Why did they kill my son, and for what?”


She said investigators visited her in the spring so she could show them routes her son might have taken on his regular walks.


Joshua often walked to unwind after work, sometimes stopping at a nearby convenience store.


On the night he died, Joshua finished work early and spent time at home with Brenda before she went to bed. She was unaware he had gone out for a walk.


Brenda said she later retraced the route herself in April, walking to the spot where his body was discovered, about 600 metres from their Vanier neighbourhood home.


The lack of answers has compounded an already difficult year for the family.


Joshua’s paternal grandfather died of a heart attack in May, followed by Brenda’s brother, both of whom had travelled south from Baker Lake last year to support Brenda.


Brenda said she receives monthly grief counselling and has reached out to elders in Baker Lake for support.


“Me and my family have been going through a really, really rough time emotionally,” she said. “We are trying to keep it together, but we’re also getting a lot of support from the right people.”


Brenda hopes someone will come forward with information that could help investigators.


“My son’s life is gone and now we have to visit his gravesite,” she said.


Joshua was buried in Winnipeg near his paternal grandmother, allowing family members to visit his gravesite more easily.


Joshua’s cousin, Alethea Noah, said the uncertainty has made grieving harder.


“The anger is a part of grief, but when it’s a situation like this, when somebody’s life was taken from them and we don’t know who [did it], and there’s no justice, it definitely heightens the anger,” Noah said.


Noah helped connect Joshua and his older brother Curtis with youth programming at Ottawa’s Inuuqatigiit Centre for Inuit Children, Youth and Families when the family moved to Ottawa in 2019 from New Brunswick. 


“He was the kind of youth who never complained and was just a joy to have around for everybody,” she said.


Joshua went on to study culinary arts at Algonquin College after

developing a passion

 for cooking. He worked at C’est Bon cooking school and Ottawa restaurant Absinthe, where he was proud of his first significant job in the industry, his mother said.


“We need to say his name because he deserves justice,” Noah said. “We can’t forget him and just let him go like that.”


Stefanie Siska, co-owner of C’est Bon Ottawa, said the business will donate 22 per cent of its sales on Oct. 22 to the Joshua Qiyuk Memorial Scholarship and Memorial Bursary at Algonquin College to support

Indigenous culinary students.

author: webdev@democracynow.org (Democracy Now!)
title: Should AIPAC Register as a Foreign Agent? Zeteo Examines Pro-Israel Lobby's Influence on Elections
content:
The growing controversy over AIPAC’s impact on U.S. politics is the subject of a new Zeteo documentary titled

Night Flower: Inside AIPAC’s Fight for Influence

. The film examines AIPAC’s history and its role in shaping U.S. policy toward Israel, and questions whether its activities warrant further scrutiny under the Foreign Agents Registration Act, or

FARA

. “It says that you have to register under this law if you are acting at the request of a foreign government,” says Dion Nissenbaum, the filmmaker behind

Night Flower: Inside AIPAC’s Fight for Influence

. “And we talked to numerous people who showed us several examples of how

AIPAC

 is acting at the request of Israel.”


Referencing the title of the film,

Night Flower

, Zeteo editor-in-chief Mehdi Hasan says

AIPAC

 “blossoms in the dark, shrivels in the light. We’re trying to put some sunlight onto

AIPAC

.”

author: Amanda Audi
title: Homens praticam tiro contra imagem de Lula em clube de São Paulo
content:
Em um clube de tiro, uma dupla de homens armados pratica contra um alvo com o desenho do rosto do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT). Entre risos, eles dizem “Faz o L” e “esse não vai participar da próxima eleição”.

A câmera foca no rosto do boneco de Lula, mostrando furos de bala na parte superior da imagem. “Olha a carinha dele. Só na testa.” A legenda do vídeo é “toma essa picanha”.


No vídeo, os homens dizem:

– “Esse não vai participar da próxima eleição.”

– “Faz o L.”

– “Olha a carinha dele. Só na testa.”

Na legenda da publicação, escreveram: “Toma essa picanha”.


No vídeo, os homens dizem:

– “Esse não vai participar da próxima eleição.”

– “Faz o L.”

– “Olha a carinha dele. Só na testa.”

Na legenda da publicação, escreveram: “Toma essa picanha”.


O homem que postou o vídeo em seu perfil no WhatsApp foi identificado como Maurício Archangelo, dono de empresas na Zona Leste de São Paulo. Ao ser contatado, ele disse não se lembrar do vídeo. A reportagem explicou que ele estava, naquele momento, no dia 21 de outubro, publicado em seu status. Ele disse que ia ver e desligou. Neste intervalo, o vídeo foi apagado.


Em uma nova ligação, Archangelo disse que não sabia do que se tratava, desligou de novo e bloqueou o contato. A reportagem insistiu com outro número de telefone. Desta vez, Archangelo não respondeu às perguntas e se limitou à perguntar como foi feito o acesso ao seu status do WhatsApp.


No perfil do empresário no Instagram, que é aberto, há outra foto de Archangelo em um clube de tiro.

Ele também já postou uma imagem de um bebê de poucos meses com uma arma na parte de trás da fralda. 


Bruno Langeani, consultor sênior do Instituto Sou da Paz, avalia que a conduta de atirar na foto de um presidente pode ser enquadrada como

crime de ameaça

, que é prevista como “Ameaçar alguém, por palavra, escrito ou gesto, ou qualquer outro meio simbólico, de causar-lhe mal injusto e grave”. 


“Vindo de pessoas que têm acesso a arma de fogo e se tratando de políticos como Lula, que já tiveram a caravana em 2018 atingida por tiros e que na época da tentativa de golpe, em 2023, foi demonstrado que havia um plano para matá-lo também a tiros, isso é algo bastante grave e que deve ter providências sérias das autoridades”, afirma. Para ele, a investigação deve ser não só contra as pessoas que atiraram, mas também sobre o clube de tiro por permitir o uso dessas silhuetas em alvos de tiro”, complementa.


Em 2021, um vereador de Fortaleza foi

condenado

 a pagar indenização por danos morais após atirar numa foto de Lula. No ano seguinte, quando o petista foi eleito para o seu terceiro mandato, o PT

denunciou

 que clubes de tiro estariam usando a imagem do político em alvos e acionou a justiça.


Para o cientista político da Universidade Federal de São Paulo (Unifesp) o episódio da imagem de Lula ser usada como alvo por bolsonaristas é simbólico do processo de normalização da violência deste grupo.

“Passa a ser normal tratar adversários como inimigos a quem se deve eliminar”, aponta.


Clube de tiro já foi alvo de ação policial no passado


Publicação de Maurício Archangelo em rede social


A gravação ocorreu no Clube e Escola de Tiro 556, localizado na zona leste de São Paulo.

 O proprietário, Vinicius Monteiro Pires Inácio, afirmou estar viajando e desconhecer o episódio. Ele afirmou que os clientes “podem levar o alvo que quiserem”, desde que sejam caricaturas, e não fotos de pessoas reais. Também enfatizou que não incentiva e nem compactua com atos de incitação ao ódio.


Segundo ele, é comum que usuários do clube levem imagens como demônios ou o coringa, mas os funcionários não autorizam o uso de fotos de familiares e pessoas, famosas ou não.


Logo após ser procurado pela

Agência Pública

, o clube de tiro fez um post no Instagram dizendo que é “expressamente proibida a impressão e utilização de imagens de pessoas reais como alvos em nossas instalações.” O post cita os artigos do Código Civil e do Código Penal que atribuem a conduta como criminosa. A empresa também diz que o descumprimento “poderá resultar em medidas administrativas e, conforme o caso, responsabilização civil e criminal”.


Inácio, que é influenciador ligado a pautas conservadoras conhecido como Magnata, afirma que a empresa exige que os usuários tenham as permissões regulares para utilizar o recinto, porém “não é possível observar o que os clientes fazem o tempo todo”. 


Em sua página pessoal, ele postou um vídeo na semana …

author: webdev@democracynow.org (Democracy Now!)
title: Mehdi Hasan on AIPAC's Role in El-Sayed vs. Rogers Race in Michigan & Trump's Targeting of Ilhan Omar
content:
One of the most closely watched races in the midterm elections is in Michigan between Democrat Abdul El-Sayed and Republican Mike Rogers. El-Sayed is a former public health official who is campaigning on a platform of Medicare for All, ending military aid to Israel, and getting corporate money out of politics. Rogers is a former Republican congressman backed by President Trump.


If elected, El-Sayed would become the first Muslim to serve in the U.S. Senate. During Wednesday’s debate in Michigan, Rogers repeated the claim, without providing evidence, that El-Sayed has ties to the Muslim Brotherhood. El-Sayed has repeatedly denied the accusation.


“If Abdul El-Sayed wins, it will be a reminder that the left can win in a swing state like Michigan,” says Mehdi Hasan, editor-in-chief of Zeteo. “And it will be actually a moment to say, 'You know what? Americans rejected Islamophobia.'”

author: Unknown
title: Eski TFF Başkanvekili Lütfi Arıboğan hakkında "şike" davası
content:
Fotoğraf: Suece85/Wikimedia Commons CC BY-SA 4.0

Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığı Terör Suçları Soruşturma Bürosunca yürütülen soruşturma kapsamında, eski Türkiye Futbol Federasyonu (TFF) Başkan Vekili Lütfi Arıboğan hakkında iddianame hazırlandı.

Türk Ceza Kanunu’nun (TCK) 220’nci maddesinin 7’nci fıkrası kapsamında düzenlenen iddianamede, Arıboğan’ın “silahlı terör örgütüne üye olmamakla birlikte örgüte bilerek ve isteyerek yardım etme” suçundan cezalandırılması talep edildi. İddianamenin düzenlenmesinin ardından Arıboğan hakkında 25. Ağır Ceza Mahkemesinde kamu davası açıldığı bildirildi.

Arıboğan, kamuoyunda ‘2011 futbolda şike soruşturması’ olarak anılan dönemin Fenerbahçe Başkanı Aziz Yıldırım’ı ve spor camiasına ilişkin operasyonlarla ilgili başlatılan soruşturma kapsamında, 25 Aralık 2025'te ifadeye çağrılmıştı.

Arıboğan, ifadeye çağrılan eski TFF genel sekreteri Ebru Köksal, Türkiye Milli Olimpiyat Komitesi Başkanı Ahmet Gülüm ve avukat İlhan Helvacı ile birlikte daha sonra serbest bırakılmıştı.

İstanbul Başsavcılığı dört kişinin "FETÖ" mensubu kamu görevlilerince usulsüz yürütülen soruşturma ve kovuşturmalarla ilgili Mehmet Baransu’yla irtibatlı olarak işlemlere iştirak ettikleri yönünde şüphe bulunduğunu belirtmişti.

Savcılık Arıboğan ve Helvacı’yı adli kontrol talebiyle hakimliğe sevk etmişti. Köksal ve Gülüm ise ifadelerinin ardından serbest bırakılmıştı.

Hakimlik Arıboğan ve Helvacı’nın yurt dışına çıkış yasağı ve karakola giderek imza verme şeklinde adli kontrol şartıyla serbest bırakılmasına karar vermişti.

author: Soraya Kishtwari
title: Alleged Killer of Gazan 5-Year-Old Hind Rajab Goes on Holiday in the US
content:
The Israeli military commander accused of ordering the killing of Hind Rajab has been on holiday in the US – prompting calls for his arrest.


The Hind Rajab Foundation (HRF) filed a request to the US Department of Justice on 19 October to prosecute Sean Glass, who they accuse of war crimes and genocide in Gaza.


Glass recently uploaded photos and videos to social media from New York’s Central Park and Times Square, as well as an ice hockey game at Madison Square Gardens.


The foundation alleged that Glass commanded the “Vampire Empire” company of the Israeli military’s 52nd Armored Battalion, whose troops were implicated in the 2024 killing of five-year-old Rajab, alongside members of her family and paramedics sent to rescue them.


HRF said its investigation places Glass and his troops “in the direct vicinity of Hind’s vehicle” during the attack and added that the order to open fire on her family car was “most likely” given by Glass.


The filing also links Glass’s unit to the assault on Al-Shifa Hospital, the destruction of UNRWA headquarters, the razing of residential neighbourhoods and the destruction of the Rafah Crossing, a crucial lifeline for humanitarian aid into Gaza.


HRF says that Glass has publicly documented his role in the genocide in social media posts, interviews and a self-published book.


“The evidence in this file is damning and it is extensive,” said Natacha Bracq, HRF’s head of litigation, citing geolocated imagery, forensic analysis and Glass’s own public statements.


Jake Romm, HRF’s US representative, said: “Congress and successive administrations promised that the United States would never be a refuge for war criminals. Instead, it has condoned and aided their crimes.” 


He added: “Glass and his company are responsible for some of the worst atrocities of this genocide – that he now walks free and unbothered in the US is not only an insult to his victims, but to all people of conscience here in the US as well.”

author: Andrés
title: Agenda cultural, cuarta semana de octubre
content:
Más movilizaciones y marchas. Fallos y contramarchas

. La constancia, aunque a deshora, nos sostiene. Un montón de discos se presentan. Un festival de

solos de danza

  y

 8(ch0)

, en Aérea Teatro

. Norman Briski sigue con

Piedra Libre

, su último trabajo. Fernando Peña continúa el cine en fílmico todos los martes. Tenemos el bolsillo más flaco del mundo, las ganas desahuciadas, pero salir nos fortalece. Ocupemos las calles. Hay mucho para ver/ escuchar/ hacer gratuito y/o a precios módicos. R

ecorré nuestra agenda. Armá un plan. Organizate. Elegí compartir cultura. Si tenés propuestas, podés enviarlas a nuestor mail: culturasanred@gmail.com. Revisam

os la casilla hasta el lunes previo a la publicación.

Por ANRed.


Jueves 22


4ta. edición de IMPROBA,

el Festival de Improvisación Teatral de Buenos Aires, que reúne a la comunidad improvisadora local, nacional e internacional y al público general para compartir experiencias, aprendizajes y espectáculos únicos. Después de tres ediciones, IMPROBA vuelve en 2026 con su cuarta edición, consolidándose como un espacio de intercambio, formación y exhibición para artistas y público. La programación propone distintas miradas y formas de abordar la improvisación teatral, con compañías y artistas provenientes de Argentina, Uruguay, Chile y España.

Aquí la programación.


Cementerio Club.

Lanzamiento de un nuevo sello discográfico que tiene como fin resucitar joyas perdidas. Buenos Aires y Berlín se unen para crear Cementerio Club de la mano de Jay Low. Un nuevo sello que contará con un catálogo atemporal, haya nacido en un estudio casero de los años ochenta o en uno digital del presente. Aquí, su primer lanzamiento: «Trulepa» de Mimilocos, grabado en 1986 y prácticamente inhallable durante casi cuarenta años.

A todo el disco aquí.


XIV edición del festival Internacional Va Poesía Argentina

 se realizará entre el 19 y el 30 de octubre en Mendoza y Buenos Aires. A pesar del contextoeconómico, los directores del Festival, Marta Miranda y Ricardo Rojas Ayrala, volvieron aapostar al encuentro y a la construcción democrática.


Annemarie

.

 El documental de 

Mariana Sanguinetti

, bisnieta de la fotógrafa 

Annemarie Heinrich

, se sumerge en la vida y obra de esta pionera, autora de algunos de los retratos más emblemáticos de la cultura nacional. A través de su archivo, testimonios familiares y la obra de Heinrich, la directora emprende una búsqueda que trasciende el retrato de una artista para convertirse en una reflexión íntima sobre la memoria, la familia, el paso del tiempo y la propia mirada. Una película sobre una fotógrafa, pero también sobre los vínculos que construyen una vida. Estreno en

MALBA Cine

, en octubre.


Borges y México.

La exposición organizada por la

Biblioteca Nacional y la Embajada de México en Argentina

 con la colaboración especial de la

Fundación Internacional Jorge Luis Borges

 da cuenta de una relación de ida y vuelta. Amistades, influencias, afinidades y homenajes que, durante más de 60 años, construyeron un vínculo que trasciende los nombres. Una identidad cultural común entre Argentina y México, una forma de entender la literatura y un modo de habitar la lengua. A partir de libros, fotografías y objetos, la exposición explora la amistad con

Alfonso Reyes

, las coincidencias con

Juan Rulfo

, los viajes a México -en 1973, 1978 y 1981- y las muchas demostraciones de respeto y admiración del pueblo mexicano por Jorge Luis Borges. 

Borges y México

 se puede visitar hasta el 31 de diciembre de 2026; lunes a viernes de 9 a 21 hs. y sábados y domingos de 12 a 19 hs. en la Sala Leopoldo Marechal de la Biblioteca Nacional, Agüero 2502, CABA.


 


Viernes 23

author: Redazione_web
title: Ricordando Piero Del Prete
content:
Pierino non c’è più. Alla fine i suoi problemi polmonari hanno vinto, ci ha lottato per tanti anni senza mai perdersi d’animo: erano troppe le persone e le cose di cui si voleva prendere cura.


Ci eravamo conosciuti nei primi anni del secolo (si può iniziare a dire), poi, qualche tempo dopo, ad una festa di compagni a Montignoso, avevamo portato un po’ di impianto audio per uno e ci eravamo improvvisati fonici; finiti i concerti e finito il “servizio”, a notte fonda, ci siamo trovati tutti e due con la chitarra e abbiamo iniziato a suonare insieme.


Con Piero, la sorella Lilli e Dario abbiamo suonato tanto, avevamo messo su un gruppo: “Addetti alla nostalgia società cooperativa”, chiaramente non convenzionale, era un gruppo aperto dove chi voleva poteva venire e suonare con noi, e in tanti ci hanno accompagnato in quell’esperienza, poi alla morte di Dario siamo rimasti in tre. Ci chiamavamo “Avanzi di balera” o più semplicemente per nome e, in tre o in due, siamo usciti dagli stretti confini della Lunigiana e abbiamo suonato in molte occasioni di movimento. “Lo sai che per i compagni ci sono sempre”: Livorno, Alessandria, Firenze, Piombino, Milano, Torino, Reggio Emilia, Pordenone e tanti altri luoghi, tanti i compagni e le compagne che lo hanno conosciuto.


Ho usato all’inizio l’espressione “prendere cura”, perché Piero (a dire il vero si chiamava Pietro, ma nessuno usava quel nome) era una persona ferma, ma dolcissima, capace di prendersi cura di tutto ciò che gli stava a cuore: la compagna Nicoletta, le figlie, le nipoti e i nipoti, la sorella gli amici, i compagni.


Ma anche le cose: era un artigiano sensibile (potrei dire un artista, ma lui non avrebbe apprezzato): un restauratore di mobili minuzioso, un bravo liutaio, un disegnatore e un grafico di una attenzione estrema, oltre che un ottimo musicista.


Ma forse era solo per la sua innata capacità di prendersi cura, che fosse una musica, un disegno, l’anta di un armadio… piuttosto che un animale o una pianta: il suo orto era un giardino ogni seme aveva una storia, ogni pianta era “la” pianta.


Abbiamo viaggiato tanto insieme, sempre e comunque per strade secondarie, perché il viaggio è importante quanto la destinazione se non di più, e poi era il nostro modo di prenderci cura di noi, e abbiamo parlato tanto, io alla giuda e lui attento al paesaggio, sempre pronto a farmi fermare per andare a vedere meglio un particolare che valeva la pena, magari anche solo un albero o un muro a secco, piuttosto che per fare attraversare la strada a delle rane. Era una persona curiosa e aperta, affascinata da tutto ciò che era “pratica” e parlavamo di tutto, dal come rapportarsi ai bambini, ai metodi di coltivazione dei peperoni alle Canarie, dall’incatenatura del piano armonico della chitarra classica, alle tecniche casearie a latte crudo… Mi parlava dell’infanzia nel Salernitano, della gioventù in Brianza, di una Milano scomparsa da mezzo secolo, e poi del trasferimento in Lunigiana, dei Bandito Maria: il gruppo col quale da giovani, assieme a Lilli, Dario e altri avevano rischiato di finire a Sanremo… e ancora di Hierro, la sua casetta in montagna, il lavoro che gli era costato, la pesca nell’oceano, la gioia di quell’isola, gli amici…


E per me sei stato un amico, un compagno, un fratello.


Ciao Piero: oltre quel monte il confine: il nostro è stato un bel viaggiare.


Dielle


L'articolo

Ricordando Piero Del Prete

 proviene da

.

author: Matthew McWade
title: The Illusion of Patient Rights in Psychiatric Units
content:
I

 have been aware of patient rights since I began working as a Certified Peer Specialist in 2006. I had the privilege of serving as emcee at an M-POWERed event at the statehouse in 2009, and participated in testimony related to Massachusetts’ Restraint and Seclusion Initiative around the same time. I worked for a year at The Transformation Center, a wing of M-POWER, the now-defunct grassroots political organization that secured Massachusetts mental health patients their six fundamental rights on psych units. I knew each of the six fundamental rights by heart (humane environment, daily private visitors, professional communications, uncensored mail, phone access, and outdoor access), but after becoming a peer specialist, I rarely experienced psychiatric hospitalization myself and had little opportunity to see how well those rights were upheld.


During a manic episode in late 2025, I felt little fear about voluntarily admitting myself to my local psych hospital because I assumed my rights would be respected. After a single weekend, I was astonished by the poor implementation of the six fundamental rights, and my mental state deteriorated as a direct result of the psych unit’s inability to uphold even the most basic of those rights.


Feeling sure that I could manage my mania and medication on my own, I asked for an immediate discharge, which was not granted (I signed a three-day notice but was told I would be taken before a judge — recalling my commitment in 2002 where the judge took one look at me and committed me without asking me a single question or providing me an opportunity for defense, I was hesitant to trust the local courts). Reviewing the rights board in the hallway, I vocally indicated to the staff where their policy deviated from state law, and I was met with disregard that devolved to disdain. Trapped and contemplating how to either exercise my rights or win my freedom to return to the community, I took comfort in the fact that at least the newest of the six fundamental rights, the right to fresh air, was being honored (though without access to cigarettes, which continually annoyed the other patients).


My first effort towards garnering assistance was to speak privately with my parents about my concerns, including the psych doctor’s stubborn refusal to discuss my discharge, but I was met with deprivation as my right to receive daily visitors of my own choosing, in private and at reasonable times, was immediately trampled. My elderly parents, who have vision problems and live over an hour away from the hospital, politely requested an earlier visiting time, in the early afternoon. The established visiting hours were 6pm-8pm (after the sun has set in late-autumn New England) which prevented my parents from ever having an extended visit with me during my entire psych ward stay considering they could not drive at night. They merely dropped off clothes, my phone, and a book and then left.


My next attempt was to have a private conversation with my mother about how I might secure a discharge, but I was met with another right denied when I was told I needed a “prescription” from the psych doctor for a private phone call (which she did not grant). I was told that even if I did get the “prescription phone call,” a staff member might be required to stand in the room (no one explained how the conversation could remain private with a staff member in the room). My mother insisted on having this phone conversation, being as upset as I was that they would not let me leave. I was left with two options: I could either call my mother from the crowded cafeteria during my allotted 30 minutes of daily cell phone access (with another staff member sitting five feet away with a sign-in sheet pretending not to listen as I whispered over the other 15 local phone conversations), or I could call my mother from one of the two “very private” payphones, each about seven feet from the staff office in the “secluded” hallway that everyone needed to walk through to arrive at the cafeteria or the TV room.


Reading the patients’ rights board, I noticed an unnumbered set of rights including the “right to know why you are being held on the psych unit and the stipulations for your discharge.” Waiting the entire evening, I knew I could question my assigned psych doctor the next day. Working with this doctor became a chore. She would devote barely two minutes to speaking with me regardless of my concerns, and refused to meet with me at all …

title: Cerignola si ferma contro il carovita
content:
Continuiamo a raccontare le proteste in corso nel sud Italia, questa volta a partire dall’esperienza di chi si è mobilitato in Puglia, in particolare a Cerignola. Agricoltori, auto trasportatori, lavoratori e studenti si sono uniti nelle piazze e, ci spiega Vincenzo Pinnelli, uno dei portavoce del movimento, continueranno a farlo.


Da Radio Blackout


Non sono ritenute risposte sufficienti le promesse di Salvini di ieri a Milano, al tavolo di negoziazione con gli auto trasportatori. Si aspetta il prossimo incontro e intanto la mobilitazione continua. Anche perché sul piano agricolo, le risposte arrivate finora sono ancora meno.


Proseguono i blocchi degli auto trasportatori in Puglia, Calabria e Campania, e da ieri si estendono al centro Italia, in particolare Lazio e Molise. Le conseguenze materiali si sentono già: supermercati senza prodotti freschi in diverse di queste regioni e più in generale perdite economiche non indifferenti per il sistema. Insomma emerge forte chiaro la voce ma anche il potere di alcune delle categorie che il sistema della GDO prova ad invisibilizzare.

author: CNT Madrid
title: Bajemos los alquileres, subamos los salarios: 11N, huelga general
content:
Llevamos tiempo escuchando con atención, respeto y convicción las luchas que impulsan los colectivos del movimiento por la vivienda: los sindicatos de inquilinas e inquilinos, las PAH, las asambleas de barrio, los grupos contra los desahucios y todos los espacios libertarios y populares que se plantan frente al acoso inmobiliario. Para la CNT, este conflicto no es una causa ajena ni una lucha que contemplemos desde fuera. Quien nos explota durante la jornada laboral pertenece a la misma clase que nos arrebata el techo cuando salimos del trabajo.


El próximo 11 de noviembre vamos a la huelga general. Lo hacemos desde el anarcosindicalismo, con la acción directa como herramienta y la autoorganización como garantía de nuestra fuerza colectiva. No estamos ante un desajuste del mercado ni ante una crisis pasajera: sufrimos una ofensiva patronal y rentista en toda regla. Mientras nos exprimen con salarios de miseria, jornadas interminables y horas extras impagadas, los rentistas y la patronal inmobiliaria devoran una parte cada vez mayor de nuestros ingresos. Nos quieren explotadas en el trabajo y desahuciadas en la calle.


Es hora de señalarlo sin rodeos: patronales y rentistas son enemigos de la clase trabajadora. Son las dos caras de una misma maquinaria de dominación capitalista. Mientras el empresariado abarata el despido, precariza nuestras vidas y ataca nuestras secciones sindicales, bancos, fondos buitre y grandes tenedores acaparan viviendas, disparan los alquileres y expulsan a las familias trabajadoras de sus barrios. Su beneficio es nuestro empobrecimiento; su acumulación, nuestra precariedad. No hay intereses comunes que conciliar entre quienes especulan con nuestras necesidades y quienes tenemos que luchar para satisfacerlas. Hay un conflicto de clase que no podemos ignorar.


Desde la CNT lo decimos claramente: no depositamos nuestra confianza en las leyes ni en los gobiernos, sean del color que sean. La legislación sobre vivienda y las promesas de los despachos parlamentarios no han resuelto el problema de fondo: un sistema que convierte un derecho básico en una fuente de lucro y protege la acumulación especulativa frente a las necesidades de la mayoría. La historia del movimiento obrero nos enseña que los derechos no se conquistan implorando a las instituciones, sino organizándonos desde abajo, mediante la huelga, el boicot, la solidaridad de clase, la acción directa y el apoyo mutuo.


La huelga general del 11 de noviembre debe ser un golpe sobre la mesa frente a la alianza entre la patronal y el rentismo. Exigimos una bajada inmediata y drástica de los alquileres; el cese de todos los desahucios cuando no exista una alternativa habitacional digna; la expropiación social, sin indemnización, de las viviendas acumuladas con fines especulativos por bancos, SOCIMI y fondos buitre; y el fin de la mercantilización de un bien imprescindible para la vida. La vivienda debe estar al servicio de quienes la habitan, no de quienes hacen negocio con nuestra necesidad de tener un techo.


Porque no puede haber justicia social mientras seamos pobres en el trabajo y precarias en nuestros hogares. Porque la lucha por una vivienda digna es también una lucha sindical. Porque frente a quienes pretenden enfrentarnos y aislarnos, tenemos la fuerza de organizarnos, apoyarnos y luchar juntas.


Si la patronal nos aprieta y los rentistas nos asfixian, la respuesta de la clase trabajadora será colectiva y contundente: paramos la producción, paralizamos el consumo y tomamos las calles.


¡El 11 de noviembre, huelga general!


¡Contra la explotación laboral y el rentismo, organización y lucha!


¡La vivienda es un derecho, no un negocio!


¡Unamos las luchas de la clase trabajadora!

title: HANA: Iranian regime abducts and disappears Kurds
content:
The HANA Human Rights Organization has published a report on the arrest and abduction of Kurds by the Iranian regime.


According to the report, Diyako Bayezîdî and Mustafa Coşkar, both from Mahabad, were detained by the Iranian regime’s intelligence forces in the city and taken to an undisclosed location. The report also stated that 17-year-old Îlya Lutfî Tormakçî, who lives in the city of Baneh, was abducted by masked forces affiliated with the Iranian regime.


The report further noted that 19-year-old Ehed Meyhenxahî, from the Shino district of Urmia, was arrested on 19 October and transferred to Naghadeh Prison following a five-year prison sentence imposed on him.


Ehed Meyhenxahî had previously been detained by Iran’s Ministry of Intelligence (Ettelaat) on 24 January 2026, without a prosecutorial order, and was released on bail approximately one month later. He was subsequently sentenced to prison by the Shino Revolutionary Court on charges of “assisting anti-Iran opposition.”


The Hana Human Rights Organization’s report also stated that on 16 October, intelligence forces of the Iranian regime raided the home of Aram Eminî in Saqqez and abducted him without a written warrant or a prosecutorial order. The report said that, despite five days having passed, no information was yet available regarding Aram Eminî’s whereabouts.

author: Unknown
title: Diyarbakır Bar Association: 568 rights violations against children recorded in six months
content:
The Diyarbakır Bar Association’s Children’s Rights Center compiled reports of children’s rights violations that came to public attention during the first six months of the year. According to the report, a total of 344 children lost their lives during this six-month period. Of these children, 326 died from preventable causes, while 18 died under suspicious circumstances.


A total of 224 children were involved in cases involving sexual offenses, violence, and grievous bodily harm, while the total number of children affected by violations of the right to life and other forms of victimization was recorded at 568.


Recommendations


The report outlined the following structural and legal recommendations:


- School Security, Public Safety in Surrounding Areas, and Disarmament: Physical inspections and X-ray barriers should be installed to prevent weapons such as smooth bore hunting rifles and knives from being brought into educational institutions. Criminal penalties for civilian gun ownership should be increased.


- MESEM Programs Should Be Suspended: MESEM programs, which place children in heavy and hazardous occupations, should be suspended. Industrial facilities and construction sites should be inspected by independent, multi-stakeholder monitoring boards.


- Comprehensive Protection for Children of Seasonal Agricultural Workers: Families’ journeys to and from work locations should be documented. Transportation in unsafe vehicles should be prohibited, and mobile daycare centers should be made compulsory in accommodation areas.


- Early Warning and Psychosocial Support: During examination periods such as the LGS and YKS, school counseling staff should be increased to address academic pressure. “Early Risk Alert Networks” should be established to intervene within 48 hours at the homes of children who are frequently absent from school or reported to be in crisis.


- Urban Design and Waterways Should Meet “Child-Friendly” Standards: The State Hydraulic Works (DSİ), the General Directorate of Highways, and municipalities should be required to enclose irrigation canals, ponds, and stream beds with tall, vertical-panel fences.


- End Impunity in Suspicious Child Deaths: In all cases classified as “suspicious death,” “accidental shooting at home,” or “falling from a balcony,” investigators should thoroughly examine the possibility of hidden domestic abuse, systematic violence, and cyber-blackmail.


568 rights violations


The report continued:


“The data documenting 568 child rights violations during the first six months of 2026 demonstrate that Türkiye’s child protection system remains reactive—initiating legal proceedings only after an incident has occurred—while preventive, risk-anticipating, and protective public policies are not being implemented in a comprehensive manner.


Ensuring the full protection of children’s rights to life, health, and safety requires state institutions, the judiciary, the education and healthcare systems, local authorities, and civil society to urgently implement a child-centered, rights-based, and binding child protection policy.”

author: Unknown
title: Second issue of Academy of Social Science Journal published
content:
The Academy of Social Science is an intellectual and political initiative devoted to the development of an integrative social science—“the sociology of freedom.” Inspired by the ideas of Abdullah Öcalan, the Academy explores human possibility, collective freedom, communality, and, in general, building of democratic modernity beyond domination and exploitation.


The journal of the Academy of Social Science,

Democratic Modernity

, is a project to rethink social science as a means of human emancipation rather than simply an academic field of study. Its motto,

Towards a Sociology of Freedom

, is strongly influenced by all struggles for freedom and equality, including Abdullah Öcalan’s paradigm of Democratic Civilization, the concept of democratic modernity, the revolutionary experience of Rojava, and the Kurdish women’s freedom movement. 


The journal critiques capitalism, hierarchical institutions, and conventional disciplinary boundaries, advocating instead for forms of social organization grounded in communal life, dignity, ecological awareness, and democratic participation.


The journal combines essays on political theory, sociology, art, food systems, jineolojî, knowledge, and community organizing. The journal will also be the address where the fruit of research communes such as

Long Histories of Democratic Civilization

,

Democratic Foodways

,

Peace

 and

Democratic Confederalism

 and others are shared. Contributors include scholars, activists, and political thinkers, culminating in being an interdisciplinary intellectual project: an attempt to develop a “unified social science” that can support collective resistance, alternative forms of governance, and the practical imagination of a freer society.


Our first issue came out with the title of Towards a Sociology of Freedom, our second issue is the Commune. 


The Commune


This issue explores the commune as a living form of freedom, democracy, solidarity, and social transformation.


In the editorial, Nick Mattheou and the Journal’s Editorial Collective introduce the issue’s central questions. Mustafa Karasu, in

“Kurdistan, the Commune and the Shaping of a Democratic Middle East,”

 presents democratic modernity as a hopeful and practical path centered on women’s liberation, grassroots democracy, and communal confederalism.


In

“Peace, the Commune and the State,”

 Mechthild Exo examines how women’s leadership, grassroots democracy, and the collective shaping of freedom can contribute to a lasting and just peace. Mathijs van de Sande and Gaard Kets, in

“The Many Meanings of the Commune,”

 trace the Paris Commune’s varied interpretations and its continuing emancipatory potential.


We are honoured to publish Abdullah Öcalan’s exclusive contribution,

“The Commune: Founding Unit of Democratic Society,”

 alongside the translation of a poem he wrote in 2000. Together, these texts trace a path toward common life founded on freedom.


In

“We All Have a Story to Tell,”

 Shahrzad Arshadi reflects on art’s power to overcome individualism and nurture collective life, drawing on the resilience of Kurdish women and the philosophy of the commune. Bengi Akbulut, in

“The Commune as an Economic Form,”

 explores how communal organization can reunite production and reproduction, meet genuine social needs, and create a non-patriarchal alternative to systemic exploitation.


Targol Mesbah’s

“Kitchen Experiments: An Invitation to a Democratic Foodways Commune”

 follows the journey of rhubarb to reveal the violence of global capitalism and the sustaining power of communal food practices and traditional knowledge. The article concludes with an ancient Kurdish recipe.


In

“Multinaturalist Ecologies and Commons: Between Latin America and the Middle East,”

 Ana Paula Morel connects radical ecological perspectives across regions and offers a vision of reclaiming the commons and creating democratic, living territories beyond the nation-state.


The issue also presents the speech

“Women in the Struggle: Self-Defense, Resistance and Territorial Protection”

 by Munduruku Wakoborun, delivered at the 2013 Network for Alternative Quest in Hamburg. A review of

Kurdish Women’s Stories

 (2021), edited by Houzan Mahmoud, by Pat Huff and Salima Tasdemir, completes the issue.


The cover and interior artwork by Mona Caron deepen these reflections, connecting the legacy of all these struggles and articles, together with an article on her piece. 


All of these articles …

author: Unknown
title: Philosopher Berardi: Abdullah Öcalan is a beacon of hope in the darkness of our time
content:
Support for the Peace and Democratic Society Process continues to grow among internationally renowned intellectuals, writers, and thinkers. Franco Berardi "Bifo", one of the leading figures of the Italian left, sent a letter entitled “You Are a Beacon of Hope in the Darkness of Our Time” to Leader Apo through the Imrali Delegation.


Addressing Öcalan as “Dear Apo,” Berardi wrote that expectations for the future in Italy and throughout the Western world were bleak, and that the traditional strategies of the left had proved insufficient to halt the worldwide rise of hatred and aggression.


The letter reads as follows:


“Dear Apo,


I have tried many times to find the right words, but this is not easy at all. In my youth, I served short prison sentences; for this reason, I know that such messages can often sound rhetorical and hollow.


As you know very well, expectations for the future are bleak in Italy and throughout the West. The old strategies of the left are proving insufficient to stop the wave of hatred and aggression that is rising everywhere as a consequence of the defeat suffered by the working class worldwide.


Throughout your long years of imprisonment, you have had the courage to rethink the struggle strategy of the democratic Kurdish movement. Moving away from identity-based and nationalist politics marks an important turning point in the history of liberation movements.


During the years you have spent in isolation, you have succeeded in developing a strategy of struggle suited to the twenty-first century. This is why people around the world who value freedom and justice regard you as a point of reference and a guide. In the darkness of our time, your experiences remain one of the few beacons of light that allow us to look to the future with hope.”


Franco Berardi "Bifo"


Born in 1949, Italian philosopher, media theorist, and political thinker Franco Berardi "Bifo" is known for his association with the tradition of autonomist Marxism and his critiques of digital capitalism. Active in Italy’s radical left movements during the 1970s, Berardi is particularly well known for his work on transformations in labor, communication technologies, social alienation, and the psychological effects of capitalism.

title: Viminale identifica i camnionisti per rimuovere i presidi. “Non ci fermiamo”, i blocchi a sud continuano
content:
Contro il caro-carburanti

 Scaffali vuoti in Calabria, Basilicata, Campania (bloccata la A1) e in alcuni casi anche in Puglia e Sicilia; in queste 2 ultime Regioni solo alcune sigle sindacali hanno ritirato i blocchi mentre il governo, per bocca del ministro Urso, ha iniziato a identificare i camionisti “per rimuovere tutti i presidi nelle prossime ore”. I primi numeri del Viminale parlano di 1.339 identificati, 71 denunciati, 242 sanzionati sul piano amministrativo, oltre a disporre scorte di polizia per i tir non in blocco.


Da Radio Onda d’Urto


Per ora la situazione più estesa, a livello di mobilitazione resta quella in

Calabria

, dove sono fermi anche 870 panificatori, mentre gli aeroporti di Crotone e Reggio Calabria sono senza carburante; l’Enav avverte gli aerei in transito da Crotone e Reggio Calabria di “pianificare il rifornimento in precedenza e in quantità sufficiente per le tratte successive”. Le proteste, comunque, continuano e si aggiunge nelle ultime ore anche la mobilitazione dei pescatori.


Una panoramica su quanto sta accadendo in Calabria con Peppe Marra, compagno di Reggio e direnge di Usb Calabria che sta seguendo le mobilitazioni.


Non ha per ora quindi sortito troppi effetti quindi l’incontro di alcune sigle sindacali con Salvini, che ha annunciato lo stanziamento di 480 milioni agli autotrasportatori (soldi già stanziati in estate ma mai sbloccati) per far fronte al caro-carburante per il periodo da marzo a ottobre.


“Sono arrivate 32mila domande e da oggi cominciano i pagamenti”, dice il leghista; a fargli da sponda c’è Coldiretti, da anni braccio agricolo della destra di governo, che ha annullato la manifestazione con i trattori fissata per domani a Napoli dopo la mancia di Salvini. Sempre a Napoli, però, da domani l’intera Università L’Orientale – il più grande ateneo del CentroSud – entra in didattica a distanza, a causa dei blocchi e della mancanza di carburante per raggiungere le aule.

author: CNT Ponent
title: Vivir nos cuesta la vida
content:
Leer en

Castellano

Català


Castellano

Vivir nos cuesta la vida


Llevamos años viviendo una ofensiva sostenida contra las condiciones de vida de la clase trabajadora. Trabajar ya no garantiza vivir con dignidad, cobrar un salario no asegura acceder a una vivienda digna. La productividad mejora pero la jornada laboral se mantiene. Los beneficios empresariales baten récords, pero los salarios quedan estancados. El PIB sube, pero la precariedad se extiende.

La vivienda se ha convertido en un bien inaccesible para muchos de nosotros: hoy, el coste medio para acceder a un hogar supera el 50% de sus ingresos. Mientras los grandes especuladores concentran cada vez más propiedades, las trabajadoras somos condenadas a unos alquileres impagables, vivir endeudados, sufrir pisos en mal estado o no poder independizarnos.


Esta ofensiva no se detiene en la vivienda y los salarios, también se extiende sobre los servicios públicos que sostienen la vida cotidiana. El sistema sanitario y la educación pública sufren un proceso de desmantelamiento progresivo: infrafinanciación crónica, precarización de las plantillas y procesos crecientes de externalización, mientras el negocio privado gana terreno. Mientras, el dinero público se dedica al aumento del gasto militar para librar guerras que hacen subir aún más los precios.

Nos dicen que ésta es la legislatura de la vivienda, o que la economía va mejor que nunca. Pero, en la realidad, los trabajadores no hemos notado nada de esto y seguimos sufriendo para vivir dignamente.

Pero en los últimos meses hemos vivido también cosas esperanzadoras. La comunidad educativa ha hecho huelgas históricas. El campesinado ha conseguido paralizar autopistas y puertos por decir lo suficiente. Y las manifestaciones por la vivienda han logrado obligar a los gobiernos a hacer leyes que no querían hacer. Estos meses hemos visto cómo sólo luchando podemos conseguir mejorar nuestras vidas. Ahora es hora de redoblar la lucha.


Por eso exigimos:


Bajada de los precios de alquiler

El precio del alquiler no puede fijarlo el mercado. Por eso es necesario reformar el índice de referencia de los precios del alquiler y vincularlo a los salarios.


Prohibición de desahucios sin alternativa y contratos indefinidos

Es necesario garantizar las condiciones mínimas de estabilidad residencial como condición para tener una seguridad material. Por eso reclamamos la prohibición de todos los desahucios en casos de personas vulnerables y sin alternativa residencial y que los contratos de alquiler sean indefinidos.


Expropiación de viviendas de bancos y fondos voluntarios

Es necesario recuperar las viviendas de los grandes especuladores y ponerlas bajo control público, así como prohibir las compras especulativas para evitar su acaparamiento.


Construcción de un parque público de vivienda

Es necesario construir un verdadero parque público de vivienda, financiado mediante un impuesto especial al rendismo. También hay que asegurar que sea totalmente público, eliminando los topes de ingresos mínimo para acceder.


Reconocimiento de los derechos sindicales

Los derechos deben garantizarse a través de la autoorganización de los trabajadores. Por eso es necesario reconocer los derechos sindicales en materia de vivienda, incluyendo el derecho a la negociación colectiva, a la representación sindical ya la huelga de alquileres cuando se conviertan en situaciones de incumplimiento por parte de la propiedad.


Aumento del Salario Mínimo Interprofesional (SMI) hasta los 1.600€ y Pensión mínima igual al SMI.

El salario mínimo debe garantizar condiciones de vida dignas. Hoy no lo hace.


Reducción de la jornada laboral a 35 horas semanales que los convenios siempre podrán pactar su reducción.

Reducir la jornada significa repartir el trabajo y combatir el paro, mejorar la salud, la calidad de vida y la conciliación.


Incremento de los salarios con la pérdida efectiva de poder adquisitivo.

Por parte muy importante de la población trabajadora, el alquiler o hipoteca absorben entre el 40% y el 60% de los ingresos, pero su ponderación en el IPC es insuficiente, generando una distorsión entre inflación oficial y coste real de la vida.


Defensa de todos los servicios públicos.


Ni salarios por tierra ni vivienda por las nubes.

author: Unknown
title: Seydayê Cegerxwîn 42 sal berê koça dawî kir
content:
Bi ser koça dawî ya helbestvan û nivîskarê kurd seydayê Cegerxwîn re 42 sal derbas bûn. Cegerxwîn, di sala 1903an de li bajarokê Hesarê yê girêdayî navçeya Kercewsa (ku niha girêdayî Êlihê ye) Mêrdînê ji dayik bû. 


Bi destpêkirina Şerê Yekemîn ê Cîhanê re tevî malbata xwe di sala 1914an de koçî bajarê Amûdê yê Rojavayê kir.  


Cegerxwîn, li vir li ber destê hinek pêşengên olê yên kurd hate perwerdekirin û di sala 1928’yan de dest bi nivîsandina helbestên kurdî kir. Cegerxwîn, Celadet Elî Bedirxan û rêhevalên xwe di sala 1932’yan de li paytexta Sûriyeyê Şamê dest bi weşandina kovara Hawarê kirin û navê Cegerxwîn cara ewil li wir hate bikaranîn. Cegerxwîn, sedema vê jî wiha rave dike: “Ez jî mîna gelê xwe birîndar im. Dilê min birîndar e. Ji cegera min min xwîn tê. Lewma min navê xwe kir kesê cegera wî xwîn jê tê anku Cegerxwîn.” 


Xoybûn


 Cegerxwîn, di nava rêxistina Xoybûnê de jî cih girt ku di Serhildana Agiriyê de xwedî roleke mezin e. Di sala 1946’an de derbasî Qamişloyê bû û xebatên xwe yên polîtîk domand. Cegerxwîn, di heman salê de bû serokê rêxistina siyasî ya Civata Azadî û Yekitiya Kurd.  Di sala 1948'an de endamê Partiya Komunîst a Sûriyeyê bû û 6 sal piştre ji bo bikeve Parlamentoya Sûriyeyê bû namzetê parlamenteriyê. 


Cegerxwîn, heta sala 1957’an serokatiya saziya Komîteya Aştiyê ya ji bo Cizîrê kir. Piştre ji Partiya Komunist a Sûriyeyê veqetiya û tev li Partiya Demokrat a Kurdistanê ya Sûriyeyê bû. 2 sal piştre dîsa çû Iraqê û li Zanîngeha Bexdayê bû yekemîn mamosteyê ku bi zimanê kurdî dersê dide. Cegerxwîn, di vê pêvajoyê de ji bo zimanê kurdî gelek xebat kir û gelek xwendekar gihand. 


Li Qamişloyê hate binaxkirin


Cegerxwîn, ji ber xebatên xwe yên siyasî, di sala 1963’yan de li Şamê hate girtin. Piştî berdanê jî li gorî rêzê derbasî Herêma Federe ya Kurdistanê, Lubnan û bajarê Swêdê Stockholmê bû. Di 22’yê cotmeha sala 1984’an de jî li Stockholmê wefat kir. Cenazeyê wî li Qamişloyê hate definkirin.  


Ji Mêrdînê heta Stockholmê, ji Bexdayê heta Lubnanê, ji Rojava heta Herêma Federe ya Kurdistanê, Cegerxwîn di vê pêvajoyê de gelek berhemên navdar nivîsand. Di gelemperiya berhemên wî de jî mijara esasî têkoşîna gelê kurd a li dijî burjuvaziyê bû. Cegerxwîn, zextên li gelê kurd tên kirin, înkar, pişaftin, bêkarî, xizanî û çerxa kedxwariyê di helbestên xwe de hûnand. Her wiha Cegerxwîn di helbestên xwe de bal kişand ser azadî, aştî û dijbertiya şer. 


Berhemên Cegerxwîn


Cegerxwîn, "Prîsk û Pêtî (1945)", "Sewra Azadî (1954)", "Kî me Ez? (1973)", "Ronak (1980)", "Zend-Avista (1981)", "Şefeq (1982)", "Hêvî (1983)", "Aşîtî", "Salar û Mîdya" û dîwanên wî yên "Şerefnama Menzûm". Bi gelek çîrok û lêkolînên xwe ve ji bo wêjeya kurdî bû çavkaniyeke giranbiha. Gelek berhemên wî piştre hatin qedexekirin û gelek helbestên wî ji hêla stranbejêna ve bûn stran. 


Saziyên ku bi navê wî hatine vekirin


Piştî mirina Cegerxwîn, navê wî li gelek navendên çandan, park û cadeyan hate kirin. Lê belê piştî di sala 2016’an de qeyûm li şaredariyan hate tayînkirin, bi taybet jî saziyên bi navên wî hatin girtin û navên cade û kolanên navê wî lê hatibû kirin jî hatin guherandin.


Stranên ku ji ber helbestên Cegerxwînî hatine çêkirin

Derbarê Cegerxwînî de


Helbestvanê kurd Cegerxwîn di sala 1903yan de li gundê Hesarê ya girêdayî navçeya Kercewsa Êlihê tê dinê. Navê wî Şêxmûs e. Qey qederê wisa dixwest, ku Cegerxwîn jiyaneke zor û zehmet derbas bike, dema dê û bavê wî dimirin ew sêwî dimîne. Jiyana wî bi zor û zehmetiyan re derbas bûye. Lê Cegerxwîn zû bi zû ji vê rewşê derket û berê xwe da zanistiyê, li cem şêx û melan li medreseyan li zanînê geriya, dest bi xwendina feqetiyê kir. Heft heşt salan bi vî awayî xwendin tewa kir û (îcaza) xwe li cem Mele Fethule stand, pişt re hinekî meletiya gundan kir. Du bûyerên mezin di herêmê de çêbûn, ev bûyer bûn sedemên guhertinê di kesetiya Cegerxwîn de, berê wî bi xurtî ber bi niştimanperweriyê de dan.


Cegerxwîn koçî bajarê Qamişlo yê Rojavayê Kurdistanê dike. Di vê demê de Cegerxwîn dest bi nivîsandina helbestê kir û di kovara Hewarê de helbestên xwe diweşandin. Piştî serkeftina şoreşa Iraqê sala 1958an Cegerxwîn derbasî Iraqê bû û li zankoya …

author: Harriet Williamson
title: Palantir Targets MPs With ‘Intimidating’ Letters
content:
British MPs who criticised Palantir in parliament received “intimidating” letters from the US spytech firm, Novara Media can reveal. The MPs say it won’t stop them from continuing to hold Palantir to account. 


Former Labour leader Jeremy Corbyn and Labour and Cooperative MP Rachael Maskell both received letters from Palantir’s UK CEO Louis Mosley in June, detailing the MPs’ anti-Palantir contributions in the House of Commons, and offering to meet. 


Corbyn slammed the letters from Mosley as intimidation. “I am in no doubt as to why Palantir is writing these letters to MPs: to intimidate its critics into silence,” he told Novara Media. “Their tactics of intimidation will not work and they will not shut me up. I will never be deterred from speaking out against Palantir, which should have no place in our public services whatsoever.”


Palantir, co-founded by billionaires Alex Karp and Peter Theil, has close ties to the Trump administration. Its

increasing entrenchment in the British state

 via contracts with the NHS, Ministry of Defence and various police forces has sparked

significant national security

and

data privacy concerns

. 


Palantir’s letter to Corbyn listed his comments relating to the firm in the Commons on

1 June

 as part of a debate on the appointment of Peter Mandelson to the post of US ambassador despite his well-documented friendship with the late paedophile Jeffrey Epstein. Mandelson’s now-shuttered lobbying firm Global Counsel counted Palantir among its clients. 


The letter to Maskell listed her statements and questions about Palantir on four separate occasions in parliament, from 10 February to 1 June. Both letters were sent on 3 June. 


Maskell, who represents York Central, told Novara Media the letter from Palantir wouldn’t impact her approach towards the firm. “

Clearly there is a reason as to why Palantir has paid close attention to the scrutiny that MPs have brought to this company which has been handed lucrative contracts by successive governments,” she said. “I have continually expressed my deepest concern about the government engaging with this business, before it was awarded the NHS contract.” 


Independent MP for Leicester South Shockat Adam was also contacted by Palantir. He received an email this month from Palantir’s UK public affairs lead in response to critical tweets about the warfare and AI company’s involvement in the NHS and its now-ended

contract with Leicestershire police

.


Adam told Novara Media: “As public and parliamentary scrutiny grows, MPs who raise concerns are being sent letters from the company’s lobbyists. Palantir says it welcomes scrutiny. Then let it prove it. The public has a right to know how this American company’s software is used across our NHS, our armed forces and our police, on what terms, and who answers for it. 


“Peter Thiel, Alex Karp and Louis Mosley should come to parliament and explain their role in person. Free speech and democratic oversight of public contracts are not optional.”


A Palantir spokesperson said: “There are a great deal of incorrect claims about Palantir circulating online. When politicians – sometimes inadvertently – amplify these falsehoods, they risk misleading the public. The purpose of these letters was to set the record straight. If politicians continue to repeat false claims, we will continue to correct them.”


Clive Lewis, the Labour MP for Norwich South, revealed that he had received a letter from Palantir’s new UK senior VP, Tom Watson,

warning him that the company was surveilling his activities

 relating to Palantir last month. Lewis described this as “very Big Brother” and an “implicit threat”. 


Watson is a former minister and Labour party deputy leader who now sits in the House of Lords, alongside his Palantir job. 


Lewis told Novara Media the Mosley letters in June indicate that Palantir was panicking as the Starmer administration crumbled. “They put all their eggs in one basket with Starmer, and then the writing on the wall was that he wasn’t going to be around much longer.” 


Corbyn has repeatedly

questioned the wisdom

 of using Palantir’s tech in the NHS, given the company’s role in supplying military tech to the IDF during the genocide in Gaza and

surveillance tools to ICE

 as it

conducts brutal a immigration crackdown

 in the US.

highly controversial patient data contract

 with the NHS, which campaigners and medics say has damaged trust in the health …

title: Stadtring Zweibrücken – Pride Month Edition
content:
Edit 2026-10-22: Das Video wurde schon im Sommer hochgeladen, war aber wegen eines Kopierfehlers nicht in tchncs.de auffindbar.


Nur sonntagsfrüh ist der Innenstadtring Zweibrückens per Fahrrad sicher und halbwegs erträglich zu radeln. Das Cockpitvideo zwischen Kirchgang-Aufbrüchen und Brötchenkaufverkehr zeigt die etwa vier Kilometer lange Strecke ungeschnitten – in der Version "vorwärts" gegen den Uhrzeigersinn. Die Rückwärtsstrecke im Uhrzeigersinn (rechtes Video) wurde an verschiedenen Markern geschnitten und die einzelnen Abschnitte in der Geschwindigkeit angepasst.


Eine Stadtringaufnahme vom Januar 2026 auf Youtube war in beiden Richtungen unbearbeitet. Die Strecken stimmen dort nicht so genau überein.


Zur Mitte des Videos gibt es einen Abschnitt, der wegen Einbahnstraßenregelung nicht auf der gleichen Route zurückgelegt werden kann. Hier folgt der UZS der Fruchtmarktsstraße, während gegen den UZS durch die Landauer Straße führt.


Das Projekt ist eine Arbeit im Voranschreiten mit ungewissem Ausgang. Eine Vierjahreszeiten-Collage wäre eine Idee, denn mittlerweile fehlt nur noch die Herbstversion.

author: CNT Galiza
title: La CNT logra el reconocimiento de la improcedencia de un despido disciplinario en la constructora JReformas
content:
Leer en

Castellano

Galego


Castellano

La CNT logra el reconocimiento de la improcedencia de un despido disciplinario en la constructora JReformas


La CNT acaba de sumar una nueva victoria en la lucha contra la arbitrariedad empresarial en el sector de la construcción. En esta ocasión, la intervención del sindicato permitió que se reconociera como improcedente el despido disciplinario de un compañero, tras la actuación de la empresa con absoluto desprecio por las garantías legales que amparan a todo trabajador.


El conflicto surgió tras una discusión entre el trabajador y su jefe. La empresa, lejos de tramitar correctamente el procedimiento disciplinario, dio de baja al trabajador de la Seguridad Social antes de que venciera el plazo para la audiencia previa exigida por ley. Este procedimiento, obligatorio desde la sentencia del Tribunal Supremo del 18 de noviembre de 2024, tiene como objetivo permitir al trabajador defenderse de los hechos que se le imputan antes de que la empresa adopte la decisión definitiva de despido.


Las actuaciones de la empresa JReformas constituyen una grave falta formal. Como establece la jurisprudencia, la falta de una audiencia previa efectiva invalida automáticamente el despido, puesto que la decisión de rescisión se adoptó sin dar al trabajador una verdadera oportunidad de ser escuchado. Además, la baja de la Seguridad Social no constituye una rescisión válida del contrato, sino que puede considerarse un despido de facto.


No se puede despedir a alguien por un hecho consumado. La audiencia previa no es un mero trámite, sino un derecho del trabajador. Que una empresa dé de baja a la Seguridad Social sin la audiencia previa es la prueba más clara de que su intención nunca fue cumplir la ley, sino deshacerse del trabajador cuanto antes.


El resultado de la intervención sindical fue claro: el despido fue declarado injustificado. Para la CNT, esta victoria es un nuevo recordatorio de que los empresarios no pueden eludir los procedimientos legales con impunidad, por mucho que confundan su empresa con un feudo.


La construcción sigue siendo un sector donde la arbitrariedad empresarial campa a sus anchas. Pero cuando los trabajadores nos organizamos, la ley está de nuestro lado.


La CNT recuerda a todos los trabajadores del sector que no están solos. Ante cualquier situación de despido injustificado, represalias o violación de derechos, el sindicato ofrece asesoría y defensa legal.


La construcción no es territorio comanche para los empleadores. Organízate y defiende tus derechos.


En la CNT, si los empleadores atacan, respondemos.


Galego

A CNT logra que se recoñeza a improcedencia dun despedimento disciplinario na empresa de construción JReformas


A CNT vén de sumar unha nova vitoria na loita contra a arbitrariedade patronal no sector da construción. Nesta ocasión, a intervención do sindicato permitiu que se recoñecese a improcedencia do despedimento disciplinario dun compañeiro, despois de que a empresa actuase cun desprezo absoluto polas garantías legais que asisten a calquera traballador.


O conflito xurdiu tras unha discusión entre o traballador e o seu xefe. A empresa, lonxe de tramitar correctamente o procedemento disciplinario, deu de baixa ao traballador na Seguridade Social antes de que rematase o prazo da audiencia previa que a lexislación esixe. Este trámite, obrigatorio desde a sentenza do Tribunal Supremo do 18 de novembro de 2024, ten como finalidade permitir que a persoa traballadora poida defenderse dos feitos que se lle imputan antes de que a empresa adopte a decisión definitiva de despedilo .


A actuación da empresa JReformas constitúe un defecto formal grave. Como recolle a xurisprudencia, a falta dunha audiencia previa efectiva converte automaticamente o despedimento en improcedente, xa que a decisión extintiva foi adoptada sen dar ao traballador a oportunidade real de ser escoitado . A baixa na Seguridade Social, ademais, non equivale a unha extinción válida do contrato, senón que pode ser cualificada como un despedimento de feito .


Non se pode despedir a alguén pola vía dos feitos consumados. A audiencia previa non é un papel para cubrir o expediente, é un dereito do traballador. Que unha empresa dea de baixa a un traballador na Seguridade Social antes de escoitalo é a proba máis clara de que a súa intención nunca foi cumprir coa lei, senón librarse del canto antes.
